    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P70_227",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11352",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 70,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Figure 7.11: Communication Group Client Service Description\n7.3 Optional Execution Context\nSome\nara::com\nAPI's with an asynchronous callback allow the use of an op-\ntional execution context parameter (see [SWS_CM_11352], [SWS_CM_11352],\n[SWS_CM_11354], [SWS_CM_11356], [SWS_CM_11360], [SWS_CM_11362]). The\nexecution context parameter gives the user more control over the execution environ-\nment of a method call.\n[SWS_CM_11364]\n{DRAFT}\nMinimal behaviour of provided Execution Context\nd\nAn\noptionally provided execution context executor shall:\n\u000f\nexecute every function that it was passed to.\n\u000f\nexecute each function it was passed to only once.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204)\n7.4 Network binding\nThe following chapters describe the requirements according to specific network proto-\ncol bindings.\nSince the selection of a particular network protocol binding is an integrator driven de-\nployment decision, any change in the selection of a particular network protocol binding\nor changes in the various attributes and parameters of a particular network protocol\n70 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P71_228",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10384",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 71,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nbinding shall be possible without requiring a re-compilation of the involved adaptive\napplications. The required changes to the involved adaptive application shall be limited\nto a re-linking (either static or dynamic) of the involved adaptive application.\n[SWS_CM_10384]\n{DRAFT}\nChange of Service Interface Deployment\nd\nA change of\nthe service interface deployment shall be possible without re-compiling the involved\nadaptive applications.  This means that the following changes in the service interface\ndeployment shall be possible without the need for a re-compilation of the adaptive\napplications:\n\u000f\nchanges to the concrete type of\nServiceInterfaceDeployment\nand the com-\nposed\nServiceMethodDeployment\n,\nServiceFieldDeployment\n, and\nSer-\nviceEventDeployment\n(e.g., changing a\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDe-\nployment\nto a\nUserDefinedServiceInterfaceDeployment\n)\n\u000f\nchanges to one or more attributes of meta-classes derived from\nServi-\nceInterfaceDeployment\n,\nServiceMethodDeployment\n,\nServiceField-\nDeployment\n, and\nServiceEventDeployment\n(e.g., changing the value of\nSomeipEventDeployment\n.\nseparationTime\n)\n\u000f\nbackwards-compatible changes to the technology specific service version num-\nber of the\nServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00315)\nNote that changes to\nSomeipServiceVersion\n.\nmajorVersion\nare an exception\nhere, since any change to\nSomeipServiceVersion\n.\nmajorVersion\nindicates an in-\ncompatible change of the\nServiceInterface\nand thus affects the involved adaptive\napplications mandating a re-compilation of the involved adaptive applications.\n[SWS_CM_10385]\n{DRAFT}\nChange of Service Instance Deployment\nd\nA change of\nthe service instance deployment shall be possible without re-compiling the involved\nadaptive applications.  This means that the following changes in the service instance\ndeployment shall be possible without the need for a re-compilation of the adaptive\napplications:\n\u000f\nchanges to the concrete type of\nProvidedApServiceInstance\nand/or\nRe-\nquiredApServiceInstance\n(e.g., changing a\nProvidedSomeipService-\nInstance\nto a\nProvidedUserDefinedServiceInstance\nand a\nRequired-\nSomeipServiceInstance\nto a\nRequiredUserDefinedServiceInstance\n)\n\u000f\nchanges to one or more attributes of meta-class derived from\nProvidedApSer-\nviceInstance\nand/or\nRequiredApServiceInstance\n(e.g., changing the\nvalue of the\nSomeipProvidedEventGroup\n.\nmulticastThreshold\nor the\nSomeipSdServerServiceInstanceConfig\n.\nserviceOfferTimeToLive\n).\n\u000f\nbackwards-compatible changes to the technology specific service version num-\nber of the\nServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00315)\nNote that changes to\nSomeipServiceVersion\n.\nmajorVersion\nare an exception here, since any change to\nSomeipServiceVersion\n.\nmajorVer-\nsion\nindicates an incompatible change of the\nServiceInterface\nand thus affects\n71 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P72_229",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10386",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 72,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nthe involved adaptive applications mandating a re-compilation of the involved adaptive\napplications.\n[SWS_CM_10386]\n{DRAFT}\nChange of Network Configuration\nd\nA change of the net-\nwork configuration shall be possible without re-compiling the involved adaptive appli-\ncations.  This means that the following changes in the network configuration shall be\npossible without the need for a re-compilation of the adaptive applications:\n\u000f\nchanges to one or more attributes of a concrete\nServiceInstance-\nToMachineMapping\n(e.g., changing the value of the\nSomeipService-\nInstanceToMachineMapping\n.\nudpPort\nor the\nSomeipServiceInstance-\nToMachineMapping\n.\ntcpPort\n).\nc\n(RS_CM_00315)\nAbstract network protocol bindings for service ports shall be specified inside the service\ninstance manifest to deploy network bindings of service instances.\n[SWS_CM_10590]\n{DRAFT}\nAbstract Network Protocol Binding\nd\nThe usage of\nabstract network protocol binding for\nProvidedApServiceInstance\nand\nRe-\nquiredApServiceInstance\nshall be supported to deploy network bindings of\nSer-\nviceInterface\ns. An abstract network protocol binding shall cover\nSOME/IP\n,\nDDS\nand\nUserDefined\nprotocols and is specified inside the service instance manifest. It\nis used with an\nInstanceSpecifier\nand shall be specified as followed:\n<port context>::<port name>\n, where:\n\u000f\n<port context>\nspecifies the instantiation context of the port which might be\nan instantiation path or any other unique identifiable information.\n\u000f\n<port name>\nspecifies the port name.\nNote: it is possible to specify multiple technology bindings for a port (Multi-Binding).\nc\n(RS_CM_00200, RS_AP_00137)\n[SWS_CM_10416]\n{DRAFT}\nReception of a malformed message\nd\nIn case any net-\nwork binding does receive a message, which it identifies as malformed, the message\nshall be discarded and the error shall not be propagated to the application.\nc\n(RS_CM_-\n00005)\nNote: The incident should also be logged if logging is configured and the corresponding\nnetwork binding supports it.\n7.4.1 SOME/IP Network binding\nSOME/IP supports different kind of bindings:\nSOME/IP Events:\n\u000f\nuni-cast is one-to-one communication\n\u000f\nmulti-cast is one-to-many communication\n72 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P73_230",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10000",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 73,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nIn case the active subscriptions will reach the multi-cast-threshold the communication\nparadigm will be switched from uni-cast to multi-cast to gain a better network utilization.\nBelow the multi-cast-threshold\nSOME/IP\nis maintaining for a subscription a single uni-\ncast communication.\nSOME/IP Events:\n\u000f\nmany-to-one communication using multiple uni-cast communications\n[SWS_CM_10000] SOME/IP Compliance\nd\nThe SOME/IP network binding shall imple-\nment the SOME/IP Protocol and the SOME/IP Service Discovery Protocol defined in\n[4] and [6].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00205)\nThe byte order of the SOME/IP header fields is defined as network byte order by\n[PRS_SOMEIP_00368].\nThe byte order of addtional fields in the SOME/IP payload is defined as network byte\norder by [PRS_SOMEIP_00759].\n[SWS_CM_10172] Payload Byte order definition\nd\nThe byte order of the parame-\nters inside the payload shall be defined according to [PRS_SOMEIP_00369] by\nby-\nteOrder\nof\nApSomeipTransformationProps\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_SOMEIP_-\n00026)\n[SWS_CM_10240]\n{DRAFT}\nSession handling state\nd\nIn case of normal (i.e., non\nFire and Forget) method calls or getters and setters of\nFields\n(i.e., in case of\nSOME/IP messages of type REQUEST, RESPONSE, and ERROR) or if segmen-\ntation of SOME/IP messages needs to be performed (i.e. [SWS_CM_10454] and\n[SWS_CM_10455] and [SWS_CM_10456] apply and [SWS_CM_10457] does not ap-\nply) the Session handling shall be Active. Otherwise, the Session handling shall be\nInactive.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_SOMEIP_00012)\nNote: Segmentation of SOME/IP messages according to section 7.4.1.9.9.\n7.4.1.1 Static Service Connection\n[SWS_CM_02201] Static service connection\nd\nThe static connection of services\nwhich are bound to SOME/IP protocols shall be preformed by statically pre-configured\napplication end-points as described in the TPS_ManifestSpecification for a\nProvid-\nedSomeipServiceInstance\nby [TPS_MANI_03312], [TPS_MANI_03313] and for a\nRequiredSomeipServiceInstance\nby [TPS_MANI_03314], [TPS_MANI_03315],\n[TPS_MANI_03316].\nc\n(RS_CM_00710)\n[SWS_CM_02202] Service Discovery is bypassed by static service connection\nd\nThe service discovery protocols are bypassed in case of a static service connection.\nc\n()\n73 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P74_231",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_02203",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 74,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_02203] Service versioning is not checked at runtime in case of a static\nservice connection\nd\nService versions are not checked at run-time in case of a static\nservice connection since the Service Discovery has been bypassed.\nc\n()\nNote: ara::com language APIs are agnostic to static service connection.\n7.4.1.2 Service Discovery\n7.4.1.2.1 Start of service discovery protocol\n[SWS_CM_11374] Periodic link state monitoring\nd\nThe SOME/IP network binding\nshall periodically monitor and obtain the current link state of the underlying network\ninterfaces.\nNote: This information is required since the behavior of SOME/IP service discovery is\ninfluenced by the current link state as well as by changes in the link state\nc\n()\n[SWS_CM_00201] Start of service discovery protocol on Server side\nd\nThe reg-\nistration of a new offered service which is bound to SOME/IP by invoking the\nOf-\nferService\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00101]) of the\nServiceSkeleton\nclass shall\ntrigger the start of the initial wait phase of the SOME/IP service discovery protocol af-\nter link up according to [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00133].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00101,\nRS_SOMEIPSD_00024, RS_SOMEIPSD_00013)\nThe different phases of SOME/IP Service Discovery on the Server side are configured\nin the Manifest in the\nSomeipSdServerServiceInstanceConfig\nreferenced in\nProvidedSomeipServiceInstance\nelement in the role\nsdServerConfig\n. The\nconfiguration is described in more detail in TPS_ManifestSpecification by\n\u000f\n[TPS_MANI_03012] (Initial Wait Phase),\n\u000f\n[TPS_MANI_03013] (Repetition Phase),\n\u000f\n[TPS_MANI_03014] (Main Phase).\nThe corresponding timing parameters for these phases are configured via\nInitialS-\ndDelayConfig\nin the role\ninitialOfferBehavior\n,\nRequestResponseDelay\nin\nthe role\nrequestResponseDelay\n, and\nTimeValue\nin attribute\nofferCyclicDe-\nlay\n. The sharing of timers is described in [TPS_MANI_03230].\n[SWS_CM_00209] Start of service discovery protocol on Client side\nd\nWhen invok-\ning the\nFindService\nmethods (see [SWS_CM_00122] and [SWS_CM_00622]) or the\nStartFindService\nmethods (see [SWS_CM_00123] and [SWS_CM_00623]) of the\nServiceProxy\nclass, such a search request shall be considered as issuing an inter-\nnal service request as used in [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00435]. FindService shall not wait\nfor offer messages, but only check information available within the local AP-instance\n(StartFindService shall also not wait for offer messages as it only registers a handler).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00102, RS_SOMEIPSD_00024, RS_SOMEIPSD_00008)\n74 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P75_232",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_00201",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 75,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nNote: The result of a FindService call depends on the already received offers, hence\nmultiple calls might be necessary to find a service instance at all. Also, the number of\nfound service instances might vary for subsequent calls of FindService.\nNote for [SWS_CM_00201] and [SWS_CM_00209]: See also [PRS_SOMEIPSD_-\n00395], [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00397], [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00399], [PRS_SOMEIPSD_-\n00416], [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00435], [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00752], [PRS_SOMEIPSD_-\n00133], [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00805] and [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00751].\nThe different phases of SOME/IP Service Discovery on the Client side are configured\nin the Manifest in the\nSomeipSdClientServiceInstanceConfig\nreferenced in\nRequiredSomeipServiceInstance\nelement in the role\nsdClientConfig\n. The\nconfiguration is described in more detail in TPS_ManifestSpecification by\n\u000f\n[TPS_MANI_03026] (Initial Wait Phase),\n\u000f\n[TPS_MANI_03027] (Repetition Phase).\nThe corresponding timing parameters for these phases are configured via\nInitialS-\ndDelayConfig\nin the role\ninitialFindBehavior\n, and\nRequestResponseDelay\nin the role\nrequestResponseDelay\n. The sharing of timers is described in [TPS_-\nMANI_03231].\n7.4.1.2.2 FindService message\n[SWS_CM_00202] SOME/IP FindService message\nd\nThe fields in the SOME/IP Find-\nService message shall be as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Type field and the TTL field shall be set to values suitable for a FindService\nentry, which means that\n\nThe Type field shall be set to FindService (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00351]\nfor numerical value)\n\nTTL for FindService messages shall not be used, and the value may be set\nto an arbitrary value. The field is only defined in the protocol for backward\ncompatibility.\n\u000f\nThe Service ID field shall be set to a value derived from the Manifest where the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\nserviceIn-\nterfaceId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Instance ID shall be set to a value derived from the Manifest where the\nRequiredSomeipServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nrequiredServi-\nceInstanceId\nfor the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nthat is ref-\nerenced by the\nRequiredSomeipServiceInstance\nin the role\nserviceIn-\nterfaceDeployment\n. If the\nrequiredServiceInstanceId\nis set to \"ALL\"\nthen 0xFFFF shall be used.\n75 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

RS_SOMEIPSD_00013, RS_-\nSOMEIPSD_00025)\n[SWS_CM_12019] Service Discovery Endpoint Options\nd\nThe SOME/IP-SD im-\nplementation shall support [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00547],       "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 79,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\nThe Service ID field shall be set to the same value as in the OfferService mes-\nsage.\n\u000f\nThe Instance ID field shall be set to the same value as in the OfferService mes-\nsage.\n\u000f\nThe Major Version field shall be set to the same value as in the OfferService\nmessage.\n\u000f\nThe Minor Version field shall be set to the same value as in the OfferService\nmessage.\n\u000f\nIPv4 Endpoint Option shall be set to the same value as in the OfferService mes-\nsage.\n\u000f\nIPv6 Endpoint Option shall be set to the same value as in the OfferService mes-\nsage.\n\u000f\nConfiguration Option shall be set to the same value as in the OfferService mes-\nsage.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00105, RS_SOMEIPSD_00006, RS_SOMEIPSD_00005,\nRS_SOMEIPSD_00010, RS_SOMEIPSD_00014)\n7.4.1.2.5 SubscribeEventgroup message\n[SWS_CM_10377] Sending SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup messages - ini-\ntial\nd\nThe subscription to\nat least one\nEvent\n(\nServiceInterface\n.\nevent\n) of\nan\nEventgroup\n(\nSomeipEventGroup\n) by invoking the\nSubscribe\nmethod (see\n[SWS_CM_00141]) of the specific\nEvent\nclass of the\nServiceProxy\nclass shall\ncause the sending of a SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup messages in case there is\nno active subscription for the particular\nEventgroup\n(either because there was no\nprevious subscription to this particular\nEventgroup\nor the TTL of every received Sub-\nscribeGroupAck message (see [SWS_CM_00206]) for the particular\nEventgroup\nhas\nalready expired).\nThe subscription to\nat least one\nEvent\nof an\nEventgroup\nby invoking the\nSubscribe\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00141]) of the specific\nEvent\nclass of the\nServiceProxy\nclass shall\nnot\ncause the sending of a SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup messages in\ncase there is an active subscription for the particular\nEventgroup\n(because there\nwas some previous subscription to this particular\nEventgroup\nand the TTL of at least\none received SubscribeGroupAck message (see [SWS_CM_00206]) for the particular\nEventgroup\nhas not yet expired).\nThe client shall explicitly request Initial Events for Field notifier according to\n[PRS_SOMEIPSD_00703] and [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00811].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_-\nCM_00200, RS_CM_00103, RS_SOMEIPSD_00006, RS_SOMEIPSD_00015)\n79 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P80_237",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10381",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 80,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_10381] Sending SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup messages - renewal\nd\nUpon reception of an OfferService message, a SubscribeEventgroup message shall\nbe sent to refresh/renew the active subscription to the particular\nEventgroup\nif the\nTTL of an active subscription for a particular\nEventgroup\nhas not yet expired and\nthere is at least one active subscription for an Event of this Eventgroup.\nc\n(RS_CM_-\n00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00103, RS_SOMEIPSD_00006, RS_SOMEIPSD_-\n00015)\n[SWS_CM_00205] Content of SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup message\nd\nThe fields\nin the SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup message shall be as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Type field and the TTL field shall be set to values suitable for a Sub-\nscribeEventgroup entry, which means that\n\nThe Type field shall be set to SubscribeEventgroup (see [PRS_-\nSOMEIPSD_00386] for numerical value)\n\nThe TTL field shall be set to a value derived from Manifest, where\nthe\nRequiredSomeipServiceInstance\nelement aggregates the\nSomeipRequiredEventGroup\nin the role\nrequiredEventGroup\n. The\nSomeipRequiredEventGroup\naggregates the\nsdClientEventGroup-\nTimingConfig\nwhere the\ntimeToLive\nis defined.\n\u000f\nThe Service ID shall be taken from the offer message.\n\u000f\nThe Instance ID shall be taken from the offer message.\n\u000f\nMajor Version shall be derived from the offer message.\n\u000f\nThe Eventgroup ID field shall be derived from Manifest where the\nRequired-\nSomeipServiceInstance\nelement aggregates the\nSomeipRequiredEvent-\nGroup\nin the role\nrequiredEventGroup\n. The\nSomeipRequiredEventGroup\ncontains the\neventGroup\nreference to the\nSomeipEventGroup\nwhere the\neventGroupId\nis defined.\n\u000f\nIPv4 Endpoint Option shall be sent if the offer message contains an IPv4 End-\npoint Option. In this case the IPv4 Address sent in the IPv4 Endpoint Option of\nthe SubscribeEventgroup message is configured in the Manifest where the\nRe-\nquiredSomeipServiceInstance\nelement is mapped with the\nServiceIn-\nstanceToMachineMapping\nto an\nEthernetCommunicationConnector\nof\na\nMachine\n. The\nEthernetCommunicationConnector\nrefers to a\nNetwork-\nEndpoint\nin the role\nunicastNetworkEndpoint\nwhere an IPv4 Address is\nconfigured in the\nIpv4Configuration\nelement.\n\u000f\nIPv6 Endpoint Option shall be sent if the offer message contains an IPv6 End-\npoint Option. In this case the IPv6 Address sent in the IPv6 Endpoint Option of\nthe SubscribeEventgroup message is configured in the Manifest where the\nRe-\nquiredSomeipServiceInstance\nelement is mapped with the\nServiceIn-\nstanceToMachineMapping\nto an\nEthernetCommunicationConnector\nof\na\nMachine\n. The\nEthernetCommunicationConnector\nrefers to a\nNetwork-\n80 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P81_238",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_00206",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 81,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nEndpoint\nin the role\nunicastNetworkEndpoint\nwhere an IPv6 Address is\nconfigured in the\nIpv6Configuration\nelement.\n\u000f\nThe Transport Layer Protocol used in the IPv4 Endpoint option and/or IPv6 End-\npoint option shall be derived from the Manifest where the\nSomeipEventGroup\npoints either to\nSomeipEventDeployment\ns where the\ntransportProtocol\nis set to\nudp\nor to\ntcp\n. The\nSomeipServiceInstanceToMachineMapping\nelement that maps the\nRequiredSomeipServiceInstance\nto an\nEthernet-\nCommunicationConnector\nof a\nMachine\nthe transport protocol and the port\nnumber.\n\nThe UDP port shall be derived from\nSomeipServiceInstanceToMa-\nchineMapping\n.\nudpPort\n. In case the port number (\nSomeipServiceIn-\nstanceToMachineMapping\n.\nudpPort\n) is configured to 0, an\nephemeral\nport shall be used. If the port number is configured to a value different from\n0 exactly that value shall be used.\n\nThe TCP port shall be derived from\nSomeipServiceInstanceToMa-\nchineMapping\n.\ntcpPort\n. In case the port number (\nSomeipServiceIn-\nstanceToMachineMapping\n.\ntcpPort\n) is configured to 0, an\nephemeral\nport shall be used. If the port number is configured to a value different from\n0 exactly that value shall be used.\n\u000f\nThe InitialDataRequested flag shall be set to 1 for fields and to 0 for events.\n\u000f\nReserved shall be set to 0.\n\u000f\nCounter shall be set to 0.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00103, RS_SOMEIPSD_00006, RS_-\nSOMEIPSD_00005, RS_SOMEIPSD_00015)\nNote:\nIn AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform (and ara::com) there are currently no use cases\nin having parallel subscribes by the same subscriber to the same eventgroup of the\nsame service (, with the only difference being in the endpoint).\n[SWS_CM_00206] SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroupAck message\nd\nThe fields in the\nSOME/IP SubscribeEventgroupAck message shall be as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Type field and the TTL field shall be set to values suitable for a Sub-\nscribeEventgroupAck entry, which means that\n\nThe Type field shall be set to SubscribeEventgroupAck (see [PRS_-\nSOMEIPSD_00391] for numerical value)\n\nThe TTL field shall be set to the same value as in the SubscribeEventgroup\nmessage that is answered by this SubscribeEventgroupAck message (see\n[PRS_SOMEIPSD_00391])\n\u000f\nThe Service ID field shall be set to the same value as in the SubscribeEventgroup\nmessage that is answered by this SubscribeEventgroupAck message.\n81 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P82_239",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_00208",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 82,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\nThe Instance ID field shall be set to the same value as in the SubscribeEvent-\ngroup message that is answered by this SubscribeEventgroupAck message.\n\u000f\nThe Major Version field shall be set to the same value as in the SubscribeEvent-\ngroup message that is answered by this SubscribeEventgroupAck message.\n\u000f\nThe Eventgroup ID field shall be set to the same value as in the SubscribeEvent-\ngroup message that is answered by this SubscribeEventgroupAck message.\n\u000f\nThe Multicast Option(s) shall be set in the following way\n\nAn IPv4 Multicast Option shall be derived from the Manifest if a\nmulticas-\ntThreshold\nwith a value greater 0 is defined for the\nSomeipProvidedE-\nventGroup\nand a\nipv4MulticastIpAddress\nis defined for the same\nSomeipProvidedEventGroup\n.\n\nAn IPv6 Multicast Option shall be derived from the Manifest if a\nmulticas-\ntThreshold\nwith a value greater 0 is defined for the\nSomeipProvidedE-\nventGroup\nand a\nipv6MulticastIpAddress\nis defined for the same\nSomeipProvidedEventGroup\n.\n\nThe Transport Layer Protocol shall be set to UDP. Only UDP is supported\nas transport layer protocol in the IPv4 Multicast Option and/or IPv6 Multicast\nOption.\n\nThe UDP Port shall be derived from the the Manifest where the\nProvid-\nedSomeipServiceInstance\nthat aggregates the\nSomeipProvidedE-\nventGroup\nhas the\neventMulticastUdpPort\ndefined.\n\u000f\nThe InitialDataRequested flag shall be set to 1 for fields and to 0 for events.\n\u000f\nReserved shall be set to 0.\n\u000f\nCounter shall be set to 0.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_SOMEIPSD_00015, RS_SOMEIPSD_00006, RS_-\nSOMEIPSD_00002, RS_SOMEIPSD_00003, RS_SOMEIPSD_00005)\n[SWS_CM_00208] SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroupNack message\nd\nThe fields in the\nSOME/IP SubscribeEventgroupNack message shall be as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Type field and the TTL field shall be set to values suitable for a Sub-\nscribeEventgroupNack entry, which means that\n\nThe type field shall be set to SubscribeEventgroupAck (see [PRS_-\nSOMEIPSD_00394] for numerical value)\n\nThe TTL field shall be set to 0x000000 (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00394])\n\u000f\nThe Service ID field shall be set to the same value as in the SubscribeEventgroup\nmessage that is answered by this SubscribeEventgroupNack message.\n\u000f\nThe Instance ID field shall be set to the same value as in the SubscribeEvent-\ngroup message that is answered by this SubscribeEventgroupNack message.\n82 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

messages\nd\nStopping the subscription of an\nEvent\n(\nServiceInterface\n.\nevent\n) of an\nEventgroup\n(\nSomeipEventGroup\n) by invoking the\nUnsubscribe\nmethod (see\n[SWS_CM_00151]) of the specific\nEvent\nclass of the\nServiceProxy\nclass shall\nnot\ncause the sending of a SOME/IP StopSubscribeEventgroup message if there are still\nactive subscriptions for other\nEvent\ns of the same\nEventgroup\n.\nStopping the subscription of the\nlast\nEvent\nof an\nEventgroup\nby invoking the\nUnsub-\nscribe\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00151]) of the specific\nEvent\nclass of the\nServi-\nceProxy\nclass shall cause the sending of a SOME/IP StopSubscribeEventgroup mes-\nsage.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00104, RS_SOMEIPSD_00006, RS_SOMEIPSD_-\n00005, RS_SOMEIPSD_00017)\n[SWS_CM_00207] Content of SOME/IP StopSubscribeEventgroup message\nd\nThe\nfields in the SOME/IP StopSubscribeEventgroup message shall be as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Type field and the TTL field shall be set to values suitable for a StopSub-\nscribeEventgroup entry, which means that\n\nThe Type field shall be set to SubscribeEventgroup (see [PRS_-\nSOMEIPSD_00386] for numerical value)\n\nThe TTL field shall be set to 0x000000 (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00389])\n\u000f\nThe Service ID field shall be set to the same value as in the SubscribeEventgroup\nmessage.\n\u000f\nThe Instance ID field shall be set to the same value as in the SubscribeEvent-\ngroup message.\n\u000f\nThe Major Version field shall be set to the same value as in the SubscribeEvent-\ngroup message.\n83 of 525 SubscribeEvent-\ngroup message.\n\u000f\nThe InitialDataRequested flag shall be set to 1 for fields and to 0 for events.\n\u000f\nReserved shall be set to 0.\n\u000f\nCounter shall be set to 0.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00104, RS_SOMEIPSD_00006, RS_SOMEIPSD_00005,\nRS_SOMEIPSD_00017)\n7.4.1.2.7 Link Loss\n[SWS_CM_11375] Link loss on Client side\nd\nIn case the SOME/IP network binding\ndetects a link loss on the client side, the SOME/IP service discovery shall react accord-\ning to [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00752] (i.e., re-enter the initial wait phase once the link is up\nagain and the service is still requested).\nc\n()\n[SWS_CM_11376] Link loss on Server side\nd\nIn case the SOME/IP network binding\ndetects a link loss on the server side, the SOME/IP service discovery shall react ac-\ncording to [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00751] (i.e., re-enter the initial wait phase once the link\nis up again and the service is still requested).\nc\n()\n7.4.1.3 Accumulation of SOME/IP messages\n[SWS_CM_10387] Data accumulation for UDP data transmission\nd\nTo allow for the\ntransmission of multiple SOME/IP event, method request and method response mes-\nsages within a single UDP datagram, data accumulation for UDP data transmission\nshall be supported.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204)\n[SWS_CM_10388] Enabling of data accumulation for UDP data transmission\nd\nData accumulation for UDP data transmission over the\nudpPort\nand\nunicast-\nNetworkEndpoint\ndefined on the\nEthernetCommunicationConnector\nthat is\nreferenced by a\nSomeipServiceInstanceToMachineMapping\nshall be enabled\nif the attribute\nSomeipServiceInstanceToMachineMapping\n.\nudpCollection-\nBufferSizeThreshold\nis set to a value. In this case all event and method mes-\nsages that are configured for data accumulation shall be aggregated in a buffer until\na transmission trigger (see [SWS_CM_10389] and [SWS_CM_10390]) arrives and the\ndata transmission starts.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204)\n84 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P85_242",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10389",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 85,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_10389] Configuration of a data accumulation on a\nProvid-\nedSomeipServiceInstance\nfor transmission over UDP\nd\nFor a\nProvided-\nSomeipServiceInstance\nall\nmethod\nresponses and\nevent\ns for which the\nudp-\nCollectionTrigger\nis set to\nnever\nshall be aggregated in a buffer until a trigger\narrives that starts the data transmission.\nThe following trigger options shall be supported:\n\u000f\na SOME/IP message needs to be transmitted for which the\nudpCollection-\nTrigger\nis set to\nalways\n.\n\u000f\nthe\nudpCollectionBufferTimeout\nis reached for one of the SOME/IP mes-\nsage already aggregated in the buffer.\n\u000f\nthe buffer size defined by the attribute\nudpCollectionBufferSizeThresh-\nold\nis reached.\n\u000f\nadding the\nmethod\nresponse or\nevent\nto the buffer would lead to a message\nlarger than the maximum possible size (e.g. MTU size). In this case the actual\nbuffer shall be triggered before handling the new event or method response.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204)\n[SWS_CM_10390] Configuration of a data accumulation on a\nRequired-\nSomeipServiceInstance\nfor transmission over UDP\nd\nFor a\nRequired-\nSomeipServiceInstance\nall\nmethod\nrequests for which the\nudpCollection-\nTrigger\nis set to\nnever\nshall be aggregated in a buffer until a trigger arrives that\nstarts the data transmission.\nThe following trigger options shall be supported:\n\u000f\na SOME/IP message needs to be transmitted for which the\nudpCollection-\nTrigger\nis set to\nalways\n.\n\u000f\nthe\nudpCollectionBufferTimeout\nis reached for one of the SOME/IP mes-\nsage already aggregated in the buffer.\n\u000f\nthe buffer size defined by the attribute\nudpCollectionBufferSizeThresh-\nold\nis reached.\n\u000f\nadding the\nmethod\nrequest or\nevent\nto the buffer would lead to a message\nlarger than the maximum possible size (e.g. MTU size). In this case the actual\nbuffer shall be triggered before handling the new event or method response.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204)\nIn the following sections the term \"sending of a SOME/IP message shall be requested\"\nwill be used to describe the fact that the sending of the message is requested but\nmay be deferred due to data accumulation for UDP data transmission according to\n[SWS_CM_10388], [SWS_CM_10389], and [SWS_CM_10390].\n85 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P86_243",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10294",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 86,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n7.4.1.4 Execution context of message reception actions\nIn the following sections the term \"upon reception\" will be used to describe the fact that\ncertain actions (e.g, the deserialization of the payload according to [SWS_CM_10294])\nwill be performed at a point in time between the actual reception of a message and\nthe call of the corresponding API (e.g., the\nGetNewSamples\n(see [SWS_CM_00701])\nmethod of the respective\nEvent\nclass). This specification deliberately does not explic-\nitly state whether these actions will be performed in the context of message reception,\nin the context of the API call, or in a completely seperate execution context to leave\nroom for potential optimizations of a concrete ara::com implementation.\nThe only restriction imposed here refers to the execution context of the\nEventRe-\nceiveHandler\n(see [SWS_CM_00309]).  Executing the\nEventReceiveHandler\nin the context of the\nGetNewSamples\n(see [SWS_CM_00701]) method is not allowed,\nsince according to [SWS_CM_00181] the\nEventReceiveHandler\nshall use the\nGet-\nNewSamples\nmethod to access the retrieved event data.\n[SWS_CM_11270]\n{DRAFT}\nSelecting elements of the ServiceInterface for SecOC\ntransmission\nd\nIt is possible to define which elements of the\nServiceInterface\nof\nthe particular\nAdaptivePlatformServiceInstance\nshall be securedby SecOC.\nThe selection of\nServiceInterface\nelements is done by the\nServiceInter-\nfaceElementSecureComConfig\nthat is aggregated by\nAdaptivePlatformSer-\nviceInstance\n.\nThe following configuration in the\nServiceInterfaceElementSecureComConfig\nis applicable:\n\u000f\nMethods\nThe roles\nmethodCall\nand\nmethodReturn\nidentify the\nmethod(s)\nthat shall\nbe sprotected by SecOC with the configuration settings that are available in the\nServiceInterfaceElementSecureComConfig\nelement.\n\u000f\nEvents\nThe role\nevent\nidentifies the\nevent(s)\nthat shall be protected by SecOC\nwith the configuration settings that are availble in the\nServiceInterfaceEle-\nmentSecureComConfig\nelement.\n\u000f\nFields\nThe roles\nfieldNotifier\n,\ngetterCall\n,\ngetterReturn\n,\nsetterCall\nand\nsetterReturn\nidentify the\nfield\ncontent that shall be protected by SecOC\nwith the configuration settings that are available in the\nServiceInterfaceEle-\nmentSecureComConfig\nelement.\nc\n(RS_CM_00801, RS_CM_00803)\n86 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P87_244",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10287",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 87,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n7.4.1.5 Handling Events\n[SWS_CM_10287] Conditions for sending of a SOME/IP event message\nd\nThe\nsending of a SOME/IP event message shall be requested by invoking the\nSend\nmethod\nof the respective\nEvent\nclass (see [SWS_CM_00162] and [SWS_CM_90437])\n\u000f\nIf there is static service connection according to [SWS_CM_02201]\n\u000f\nIf there is at least one active subscriber and the offer of the service containing the\nevent has not been stopped (either because the TTL contained in the SOME/IP\nOfferService message (see [SWS_CM_00203]) has expired or because the\nStopOfferService\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00111]) of the\nServiceSkele-\nton\nclass has been called).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_00005, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00017)\n[SWS_CM_10288] Transport protocol for sending of a SOME/IP event mes-\nsage\nd\nThe SOME/IP event message shall be transmitted using the transport proto-\ncol defined via the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\neventDeployment\n.\ntransportProtocol\nattribute (see [TPS_MANI_03050]).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_-\nCM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_00010)\n[SWS_CM_10289] Source of a SOME/IP event message\nd\nThe SOME/IP event mes-\nsage shall use the unicast IP address and port taken from the IPv4/v6 Endpoint Option\n(see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00307] and [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00315]) of the SOME/IP Of-\nferService message ([SWS_CM_00203]) or the server address which has been stat-\nically pre-configured by the static service connection according to [SWS_CM_02201]\nas source address and source port for the transmission.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_00042)\n[SWS_CM_10290] Destination of a SOME/IP event message\nd\nThe SOME/IP event\nmessage shall use the multicast IP address and the port taken from the IPv4/v6 Mul-\nticast Option (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00326] and [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00333]) of the\nSOME/IP SubscribeEventgroupAck message (see [SWS_CM_00206]) or the client\naddress which has been statically pre-configured by the static service connection\naccording to [SWS_CM_02201] as destination address and destination port for the\ntransmission if the threshold defined by the\nmulticastThreshold\nattribute of the\nSomeipProvidedEventGroup\nthat is aggregated by the\nProvidedSomeipServi-\nceInstance\nin the role\neventGroup\nin the Manifest has been reached (see [PRS_-\nSOMEIPSD_00134]). The SOME/IP event message shall use the unicast IP ad-\ndress and the port taken from the IPv4/v6 Endpoint Option (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_-\n00307] and [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00315]) of the SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup mes-\nsage ([SWS_CM_00205]) as destination address and destination port for the transmis-\nsion if this threshold has not been reached (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00134]). In case\nmultiple Endpoint Options have been contained in the SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup\nmessage, the one matching the selected transport protocol (see [SWS_CM_10289])\nshall be used.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_-\n00042)\n87 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P88_245",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10291",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 88,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_10291] Content of the SOME/IP event message\nd\nThe entries in the\nSOME/IP event message shall be as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Service ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Manifest\nwhere the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\nser-\nviceInterfaceId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Method ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Mani-\nfest where the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\neventDeployment\n.\neventId\nby adding 0x8000 to the\neventDeployment\n.\neventId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Length (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00042]) shall be set to the length of the seri-\nalized payload in units of bytes incremented by 8 (second part of the SOME/IP\nheader that is covered by the Length)\n\u000f\nThe Client ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00702]) is unused for event messages (ac-\ncording to [PRS_SOMEIP_00702]) and thus shall be set to 0x0000.\n\u000f\nIn case of inactive Session Handling, see [SWS_CM_10240], the Session ID (see\n[PRS_SOMEIP_00703]) is unused for event messages and thus shall be set to\n0x0000 (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00932]) and [PRS_SOMEIP_00925]).\nIn case of active Session Handling, see [SWS_CM_10240], the Session ID\nis used for event messages and thus shall be incremented (with proper wrap\naround) upon every transmission of an event message (see [PRS_SOMEIP_-\n00933], [PRS_SOMEIP_00934], [PRS_SOMEIP_00521], and [PRS_SOMEIP_-\n00925]).\n\u000f\nThe Protocol Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00052]) shall be set to 0x01.\n\u000f\nThe Interface Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00053]) shall be derived from the\nManifest where the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines\nthe\nserviceInterfaceVersion\n.\nmajorVersion\n.\n\u000f\nThe Message Type (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]) shall be set to\nNOTIFICATION\n(0x02).\n\u000f\nThe Return Code (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00058] and [PRS_SOMEIP_00191]) is\nunused for event messages and thus (according to [PRS_SOMEIP_00925]) shall\nbe set to\nE_OK\n(0x00).\n\u000f\nThe Payload shall contain the serialized payload (i.e., the serialized\nVariable-\nDataPrototype\ncomposed by the\nServiceInterface\nin role\nevent\n) accord-\ning to the SOME/IP serialization rules.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00041, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00022, RS_SOMEIP_00003, RS_SOMEIP_00004)\nThe serialization rules\nare explained in section 7.4.1.9.\n[SWS_CM_10292] Checks for a received SOME/IP event message\nd\nUpon reception\nof a SOME/IP event message the following checks shall be conducted:\n88 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P89_246",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10293",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 89,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\nVerify that the Protocol Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00052]) is set to 0x01.\n\u000f\nUse the Length (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00042]) being larger than 8 in combination\nwith the Message type (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]) being set to\nNOTIFICA-\nTION\nto determine that the received SOME/IP message is actually an event.\n\u000f\nUse the Service ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) and the\nserviceInter-\nfaceId\nattribute of the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement in\nthe Manifest to determine the right\nServiceInterface\n.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Method ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) matches 0x8000 +\nthe\neventId\nattribute of one of the\nSomeipEventDeployment\ns of the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Client ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00702]) is set to 0x0000.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Interface Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00053]) matches\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nserviceInterfaceVersion\n.\nmajorVersion\n.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Return Code (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00058] and [PRS_SOMEIP_-\n00191]) is set to\nE_OK\n(0x00).\nIf any of the above checks fails the received SOME/IP event message shall be\ndiscarded and and the incident shall be logged (if logging is enabled for the\nara::com\nimplementation).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00201, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00019, RS_SOMEIP_00022, RS_SOMEIP_00003, RS_SOMEIP_00004,\nRS_SOMEIP_00008, RS_SOMEIP_00014)\n[SWS_CM_10293] Identifying the right event\nd\nUsing the Service ID (see [PRS_-\nSOMEIP_00245]) and the\nserviceInterfaceId\nattribute of the\nSomeipServi-\nceInterfaceDeployment\nelement as well as the Method ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_-\n00245]) and 0x8000 + the\neventId\nattribute of the\nSomeipEventDeployment\ns\nof the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n, the right event shall be identi-\nfied.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00022)\n[SWS_CM_10379] Silently discarding SOME/IP event messages for unsubscribed\nevents\nd\nIf the event identified according to [SWS_CM_10293] does not have an active\nsubscription because the\nSubscribe\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00141]) of the specific\nEvent\nclass of the\nServiceProxy\nclass has not been called, or the\nUnsubscribe\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00151]) of the specific\nEvent\nclass of the\nServiceProxy\nclass has been called, or the TTL of the SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup message\n(see [SWS_CM_00205]) has expired, and if there is no static service connection ac-\ncording to [SWS_CM_02201], the received SOME/IP event message shall be silently\ndiscarded (i.e., [SWS_CM_10294], [SWS_CM_10295], and the receive handler shall\nnot be invoked).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00203, RS_SOMEIP_00004)\n[SWS_CM_10296] Invoke receive handler\nd\nIn case a receive handler was registered\nusing the\nSetReceiveHandler\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00181]) of the respective\nEvent\nclass for the event determined according to [SWS_CM_10293] this registered\n89 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P90_247",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10294",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 90,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nreceive handler shall be invoked when the corresponding Event is received.\nc\n(RS_CM_-\n00204, RS_CM_00203, RS_SOMEIP_00004)\n[SWS_CM_10294] Deserializing the payload\nd\nBased on the event determined ac-\ncording to [SWS_CM_10293] the Payload of the SOME/IP event message (i.e., the\nserialized\nVariableDataPrototype\ncomposed by the\nServiceInterface\nin role\nevent\n) shall be deserialized according to the SOME/IP serialization rules.\nc\n(RS_CM_-\n00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_00028)\nThe serialization\nrules are explained in section 7.4.1.9.\n[SWS_CM_10295] Providing the received event data\nd\nThe deserialized pay-\nload containing the event data shall be provided via the\nGetNewSamples\n(see\n[SWS_CM_00701]) method of the respective\nEvent\nclass for the event determined\naccording to [SWS_CM_10293].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00202, RS_SOMEIP_-\n00004)\n7.4.1.6 Handling Triggers\n[SWS_CM_10511]\n{DRAFT}\nConditions for sending of a SOME/IP trigger\nd\nThe\nsending of a SOME/IP trigger shall be requested by invoking the\nSend\nmethod of the\nrespective\nTrigger\nclass (see [SWS_CM_00721]).\nThe SOME/IP trigger shall be sent if at least one of the following conditions is fulfilled:\n\u000f\nIf there is static service connection according to [SWS_CM_02201]\n\u000f\nIf there is at least one active subscriber and the offer of the service containing the\ntrigger has not been stopped (either because the TTL contained in the SOME/IP\nOfferService message (see [SWS_CM_00203]) has expired or because the\nStopOfferService\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00111]) of the\nServiceSkele-\nton\nclass has been called).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_00005, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00017)\nPlease note that in the Manifest configuration the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDe-\nployment\n.\neventDeployment\nis used to configure triggers in the same way as\nevents. The only difference is that in case of a trigger the\nSomeipEventDeployment\nwill reference the\nTrigger\nin the role\ntrigger\n. Therefore the following specification\nitems described in chapter 7.4.1.5 are also valid for\nTrigger\ns since a trigger defines\na special kind of an event.\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_10288]\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_10289]\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_10290]\n[SWS_CM_10512]\n{DRAFT}\nContent of the SOME/IP trigger\nd\nThe entries in the\nSOME/IP trigger shall be as follows:\n90 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\nThe Service ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Manifest\nwhere the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\neventDeployment\n.\neventId\nby adding 0x8000 to the\neventDeployment\n.\neventId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Length (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00042]) shall be [PRS_SOMEIP_00521], and [PRS_SOMEIP_00925]).\n\u000f\nThe Protocol Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00051]) shall be set to 0x01.\n\u000f\nThe Interface Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00053]) shall be derived from set\nto\nE_OK\n(0x00).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00041, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00022, RS_SOMEIP_00003, RS_SOMEIP_00004)\n[SWS_CM_10513]\n{DRAFT}\nChecks for a received SOME/IP the\nSomeipEventDeployment\ns of the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Client ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00702]) is set to 0x0000.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Interface Version (see set to\nE_OK\n(0x00).\nIf any of the above checks fails the received SOME/IP trigger shall be discarded and\nand the incident shall be logged (if logging is enabled for the\nara::com\nimplementa-\ntion).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00019, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00022, RS_SOMEIP_00003, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_00008,\nRS_SOMEIP_00014)\n[SWS_CM_10514]\n{DRAFT}\nIdentifying the right trigger\nd\nUsing the Service ID (see\n[PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) and the\nserviceInterfaceId\nattribute of the\nSomeipSer-\nviceInterfaceDeployment\nelement as well as the Method ID (see [PRS_-\nSOMEIP_00245]) and 0x8000 + the\neventId\nattribute of the\nSomeipEventDe-\nployment\ns of the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n, the right trigger shall\nbe identified.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004,\nRS_SOMEIP_00022)\n[SWS_CM_10515]\n{DRAFT}\nSilently discarding SOME/IP triggers for unsubscribed\ntriggers\nd\nIf the trigger identified according to [SWS_CM_10514] does not have an\nactive subscription, the received SOME/IP trigger shall be silently discarded (i.e.,\n[SWS_CM_00226], and [SWS_CM_00249] shall\nnot\nbe performed).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204,\nRS_CM_00203, RS_SOMEIP_00004)\n[SWS_CM_10516]\n{DRAFT}\nInvoke receive handler\nd\nIn case a receive handler was\nregistered using the\nSetReceiveHandler\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00249]) of the\nrespective\nTrigger\nclass for the trigger determined according to [SWS_CM_10514]\nthis registered receive handler shall be invoked when the corresponding Trigger is re-\nceived.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00203, RS_SOMEIP_00004)\n[SWS_CM_10517]\n{DRAFT}\nFailures in sending a SOME/IP trigger\nd\nIf the send-\ning of the\nSOME/IP\ntrigger fails locally (due to a network error which is notified to\nthe\nara::com\nimplementation), the\nara::com\nimplementation shall return\nkNet-\nworkBindingFailure\nin the Result of the\nSend()\nmethod of the respective Trig-\nger class (see [SWS_CM_00721]).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_-\n00004, RS_SOMEIP_00005, RS_CM_00004)\n92 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P93_250",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10297",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 93,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n7.4.1.7 Handling Method Calls\n[SWS_CM_10297] Conditions for sending of a SOME/IP request message\nd\nThe\nsending of a SOME/IP request message shall be requested by invoking the function\ncall operator (\noperator()\n) of the respective\nMethod\nclass (see [SWS_CM_00196])\nif there is static service connection according to [SWS_CM_02201] or if the providing\nservice instance has not stopped offering the service (either because the TTL con-\ntained in the SOME/IP OfferService message (see [SWS_CM_00203]) has expired\nor because the\nStopOfferService\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00111]) of the\nSer-\nviceSkeleton\nclass has been called).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_-\n00213, RS_SOMEIP_00006, RS_SOMEIP_00007)\n[SWS_CM_10441] Failures in sending of a SOME/IP request message\nd\nIf the send-\ning of the SOME/IP request message fails locally (in a way which is notified to the\nara::com\nimplementation), the\nara::com\nimplementation shall make the\nFuture\nre-\nturned by the function call operator (\noperator()\n) of the respective\nMethod\nclass (see\n[SWS_CM_00196]) ready according to [SWS_CM_10440].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_-\nCM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00006, RS_SOMEIP_00007)\n[SWS_CM_10298] Transport protocol for sending of a SOME/IP request mes-\nsage\nd\nThe SOME/IP request message shall be transmitted using the transport pro-\ntocol defined by the attribute\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nmethodDe-\nployment\n.\ntransportProtocol\nin the Manifest.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212,\nRS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00006, RS_SOMEIP_00007, RS_SOMEIP_00010)\n[SWS_CM_10299] Source of a SOME/IP request message\nd\nThe SOME/IP re-\nquest message shall use the unicast IP address defined in the Manifest by the\nIpv4Configuration\n/\nIpv6Configuration\nattribute of the\nNetworkEndpoint\nthat is referenced (in role\nunicastNetworkEndpoint\n) by the\nEthernetCom-\nmunicationConnector\nof a\nMachine\nwhich in turn is mapped to the\nRe-\nquiredSomeipServiceInstance\nby means of a\nSomeipServiceInstance-\nToMachineMapping\nas source address for the transmission. The port number config-\nured via\nudpPort\nshall be used to derive the source port for the transmission in case\nthe selected transport protocol (see [SWS_CM_10298]) is UDP. If this port number is\nconfigured to 0, an\nephemeral\nport shall be used. If the port number is configured\nto a value different from 0 exactly that port shall be used. The port number config-\nured via\ntcpPort\nshall be used to derive the source port for the transmission in case\nthe selected transport protocol (see [SWS_CM_10298]) is TCP. If this port number is\nconfigured to 0, an\nephemeral\nport shall be used. If the port number is configured to a\nvalue different from 0 exactly that port shall be used.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212,\nRS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00010)\n[SWS_CM_10300] Destination of a SOME/IP request message\nd\nThe SOME/IP re-\nquest message shall use the unicast IP address and port taken from the IPv4/v6\nEndpoint Option (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00307] and [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00315]) of\nthe SOME/IP OfferService message ([SWS_CM_00203]) or the server address which\nhas been statically pre-configured by the static service connection according to\n[SWS_CM_02201] as destination address and destination port for the transmission.\n93 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P94_251",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10298",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 94,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nIn case multiple Endpoint Options have been contained in the SOME/IP OfferService\nmessage, the one matching the selected transport protocol (see [SWS_CM_10298])\nshall be used.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_-\n00006, RS_SOMEIP_00007)\n[SWS_CM_10301] Content of the SOME/IP request message\nd\nThe entries in the\nSOME/IP request message shall be as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Service ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Manifest\nwhere the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\nser-\nviceInterfaceId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Method ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Mani-\nfest where the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\nmethodDeployment\n.\nmethodId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Length (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00042]) shall be set to the length of the seri-\nalized payload in units of bytes incremented by 8 (second part of the SOME/IP\nheader that is covered by the Length)\n\u000f\nThe Client ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00702]) shall be set to a value that uniquely\nidentifies the client within a\nMachine\n. - This may be achived by dynamically\ngenerating unique client IDs upon construction of the\nServiceProxy\n.\n\u000f\nThe Session ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00703]) shall be set to 0x0001 for the first\ncall of a particular method by a given client and shall be incremented by 1 af-\nter each call performed by this client for the respective method (see [PRS_-\nSOMEIP_00533]). Once the Session ID reaches 0xFFFF, it shall wrap around\nand start with 0x0001 again (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00521]).\n\u000f\nThe Protocol Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00052]) shall be set to 0x01.\n\u000f\nThe Interface Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00053]) shall be derived from the\nManifest where the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines\nthe\nserviceInterfaceVersion\n.\nmajorVersion\n.\n\u000f\nThe Message Type (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]) shall be set to\nRE-\nQUEST_NO_RETURN\n(0x01) in case the\nClientServerOperation\nreferenced\nby\nmethodDeployment\n.\nmethod\ncontains a\nfireAndForget\nattribute which is\nset to\ntrue\n. The Message Type shall be set to\nREQUEST\n(0x00) otherwise.\n\u000f\nThe Return Code (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00058] and [PRS_SOMEIP_00191]) is\nunused for request messages and thus (according to [PRS_SOMEIP_00920])\nshall be set to\nE_OK\n(0x00).\n\u000f\nThe Payload shall contain the serialized payload (i.e., the\nArgumentDataPro-\ntotype\ns of the\nClientServerOperation\nwith\ndirection\nset to\nin\nand\ninout\nserialized according to their order) according to the SOME/IP serialization\nrules.\n94 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P95_252",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10302",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 95,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_-\n00006, RS_SOMEIP_00007, RS_SOMEIP_00003, RS_SOMEIP_00012, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00021, RS_SOMEIP_00025, RS_SOMEIP_00041)\nThe SOME/IP serializa-\ntion rules are explained in section 7.4.1.9.\n[SWS_CM_10302] Checks for a received SOME/IP request message\nd\nUpon recep-\ntion of a SOME/IP request message the following checks shall be conducted:\n\u000f\nVerify that the Protocol Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00052]) is set to 0x01.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Length (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00042]) is larger than 7.\n\u000f\nUse the Message Type (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]) which is set to either\nRE-\nQUEST_NO_RETURN\n(0x01) or\nREQUEST\n(0x00) to determine that the received\nSOME/IP message is actually a SOME/IP request message.\n\u000f\nUse the Service ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) and the\nserviceInter-\nfaceId\nattribute of the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement in\nthe Manifest to determine the right\nServiceInterface\n.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Method ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) matches the\nmetho-\ndId\nattribute of one of the\nSomeipMethodDeployment\ns of the\nSomeipSer-\nviceInterfaceDeployment\n.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Message Type (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]) is set to\nRE-\nQUEST_NO_RETURN\n(0x01) in case the the\nClientServerOperation\nref-\nerenced by\nmethodDeployment\n.\nmethod\nof the\nSomeipMethodDeployment\nwith matching\nmethodId\nattribute contains a\nfireAndForget\nattribute which is\nset to\ntrue\n. Verify that the Message Type is set to\nREQUEST\n(0x00) otherwise.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Interface Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00053]) matches\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nserviceInterfaceVersion\n.\nmajorVersion\n.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Return Code (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00058] and [PRS_SOMEIP_-\n00191]) is set to\nE_OK\n(0x00).\nIf any of the above checks fails the received SOME/IP request mes-\nsage shall be discarded and the incident shall be logged (if logging is\nenabled for the\nara::com\nimplementation). In case of a received RE-\nQUEST message (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]), additionally, an ERROR\nmessage with return code set to either\nE_WRONG_PROTOCOL_VERSION\n,\nE_UNKNOWN_SERVICE\n,\nE_WRONG_INTERFACE_VERSION\n,\nE_UNKNOWN_METHOD\n,\nor\nE_WRONG_MESSAGE_TYPE\n(see [PRS_SOMEIP_00191]) shall be sent to the\nrequester, depending on the detected error.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200,\nRS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00006, RS_SOMEIP_00007, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00003, RS_SOMEIP_00019, RS_SOMEIP_00021, RS_SOMEIP_00008,\nRS_SOMEIP_00014)\n95 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P96_253",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10303",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 96,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_10303] Identifying the right method\nd\nUsing the Service ID (see [PRS_-\nSOMEIP_00245]) and the\nserviceInterfaceId\nattribute of the\nSomeipServi-\nceInterfaceDeployment\nelement as well as the Method ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_-\n00245]) and the\nmethodId\nattribute of the\nSomeipMethodDeployment\ns of the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n, the right method shall be identified.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_-\n00006, RS_SOMEIP_00007, RS_SOMEIP_00021)\n[SWS_CM_10304] Deserializing the payload\nd\nBased on the method determined ac-\ncording to [SWS_CM_10303] the Payload of the SOME/IP request message shall be\ndeserialized according to the SOME/IP serialization rules.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00006, RS_SOMEIP_00007, RS_SOMEIP_-\n00028)\nThe SOME/IP serialization rules are explained in section 7.4.1.9.\n[SWS_CM_10306] Invoke the method - event driven\nd\nIn case a\nMethodCall-\nProcessingMode\nof either\nkEvent\nor\nkEventSingleThread\nhas been passed to\nthe constructor of the\nServiceSkeleton\n(see [SWS_CM_00130]), the deserialized\npayload containing the method data (i.e., method ID and input arguments) shall be\nused to invoke the service method (see [SWS_CM_00191]) identified according to\n[SWS_CM_10303] of the\nServiceSkeleton\nclass as a consequence to the reception\nof the SOME/IP request message.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213,\nRS_SOMEIP_00006, RS_SOMEIP_00007)\n[SWS_CM_10307] Invoke the method - polling\nd\nIn case a\nMethodCallProcess-\ningMode\nof\nkPoll\nhas been passed to the constructor of the\nServiceSkele-\nton\n(see [SWS_CM_00130]), the deserialized payload containing the method data\n(i.e., method ID and input arguments) shall be used to invoke the service method\n(see [SWS_CM_00191]) identified according to [SWS_CM_10303] of the\nSer-\nviceSkeleton\nclass upon a call to the\nProcessNextMethodCall\nmethod (see\n[SWS_CM_00199]) of the\nServiceSkeleton\nclass.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00006, RS_SOMEIP_00007)\n[SWS_CM_10447]\n{DRAFT}\nDealing with unmodelled\nApApplicationError\ns\nd\nIf\nthe service method (see [SWS_CM_00191]) returnes an\nApApplicationError\ndifferent from the modeled ones (i.e., different from the ones referenced by the\nClientServerOperation\nin role\npossibleApError\nor in role\npossibleApEr-\nrorSet\n.\napApplicationError\n),treating this as a violation according to [SWS_-\nCORE_00003]. No message shall be sent back to the client.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_-\nCM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00007)\n[SWS_CM_10308] Conditions for sending of a SOME/IP response message\nd\nThe sending of a SOME/IP response message shall be requested upon availabil-\nity of a result of the\nara::core::Future\n, which either contains a valid value or\nan\nara::core::ErrorCode\nmatching one of the possible\nApApplicationError\ns\nreferenced by the\nClientServerOperation\nin the role\npossibleApError\nor\nin role\npossibleApErrorSet\n.\napApplicationError\nof the service method (see\n96 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P97_254",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10306",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 97,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_10306] and [SWS_CM_10307]) in case the Message Type of the corre-\nsponding SOME/IP request message was set to\nREQUEST\n(0x00).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204,\nRS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00007)\n[SWS_CM_10309] Transport protocol for sending of a SOME/IP response mes-\nsage\nd\nThe SOME/IP response message shall be transmitted using the transport pro-\ntocol defined by the attribute\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nmethodDe-\nployment\n.\ntransportProtocol\nin the Manifest.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212,\nRS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00007, RS_SOMEIP_00010)\n[SWS_CM_10310] Source of a SOME/IP response message\nd\nThe SOME/IP re-\nsponse message shall use the unicast IP address defined in the Manifest by the\nIpv4Configuration\n/\nIpv6Configuration\nattribute of the\nNetworkEndpoint\nthat is referenced (in role\nunicastNetworkEndpoint\n) by the\nEthernetCommu-\nnicationConnector\nof a\nMachine\nwhich in turn is mapped to the\nProvid-\nedSomeipServiceInstance\nby means of a\nSomeipServiceInstanceToMa-\nchineMapping\nas source address for the transmission. The port number config-\nured via\nudpPort\nshall be used to derive the source port for the transmission in case\nthe selected transport protocol (see [SWS_CM_10309]) is UDP. If this port number is\nconfigured to 0, an\nephemeral\nport shall be used. If the port number is configured\nto a value different from 0 exactly that port shall be used. The port number config-\nured via\ntcpPort\nshall be used to derive the source port for the transmission in case\nthe selected transport protocol (see [SWS_CM_10309]) is TCP. If this port number is\nconfigured to 0, an\nephemeral\nport shall be used. If the port number is configured to a\nvalue different from 0 exactly that port shall be used.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212,\nRS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00007, RS_SOMEIP_00010)\n[SWS_CM_10311] Destination of a SOME/IP response message\nd\nThe SOME/IP\nresponse message shall use the unicast source IP address and the source port of\nthe corresponding received SOME/IP request message (see [SWS_CM_10299]) as\ndestination address and destination port for the transmission.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_-\nCM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00007)\n[SWS_CM_10312] Content of the SOME/IP response message\nd\nThe entries in the\nSOME/IP response message shall be as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Service ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Manifest\nwhere the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\nser-\nviceInterfaceId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Method ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Mani-\nfest where the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\nmethodDeployment\n.\nmethodId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Length (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00042]) shall be set to the length of the seri-\nalized payload in units of bytes incremented by 8 (second part of the SOME/IP\nheader that is covered by the Length)\n\u000f\nThe Client ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00702]) shall be copied from the correspond-\ning SOME/IP request message (see [SWS_CM_10301]).\n97 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P98_255",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10301",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 98,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\nThe Session ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00703]) shall be copied from the corre-\nsponding SOME/IP request message (see [SWS_CM_10301]).\n\u000f\nThe Protocol Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00052]) shall be set to 0x01.\n\u000f\nThe Interface Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00053]) shall be derived from the\nManifest where the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines\nthe\nserviceInterfaceVersion\n.\nmajorVersion\n.\n\u000f\nThe Message Type (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]) shall be set to\nERROR\n(0x81)\nin case the\nClientServerOperation\nreturned one of the possible\nApAppli-\ncationError\ns referenced by the\nClientServerOperation\nin role\npossi-\nbleApError\nor in role\npossibleApErrorSet\n.\napApplicationError\n1\n. The\nMessage Type shall be set to\nRESPONSE\n(0x80) otherwise.\n\u000f\nThe Return Code (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00058] and [PRS_SOMEIP_00191]) shall\nbe set to\nE_NOT_OK\n(0x01) in case the\nClientServerOperation\nraised one\nof the possible\nApApplicationError\ns referenced by the\nClientServerOp-\neration\nin role\npossibleApError\nor in role\npossibleApErrorSet\n.\napAp-\nplicationError\n. The Return Code shall be set to\nE_OK\n(0x00) otherwise.\n\u000f\nThe Payload shall contain the serialized payload according to the SOME/IP se-\nrialization rules. In case of NO raised\nApApplicationError\n, the\nArgument-\nDataPrototype\ns of the\nClientServerOperation\nwith\ndirection\nset to\ninout\nand\nout\nshall be serialized according to their order.  otherwise in case\nof a raised\nApApplicationError\n, which is represented as an\nara::core::\nErrorCode\ncontained in the\nara::core::Result\n, the payload shall contain\nthe serialized application error according to [SWS_CM_10428].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_-\n00007, RS_SOMEIP_00003, RS_SOMEIP_00012, RS_SOMEIP_00021, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00025, RS_SOMEIP_00041, RS_SOMEIP_00008)\nThe SOME/IP serializa-\ntion rules are explained in section 7.4.1.9.\n[SWS_CM_10428] payload representing application error\nd\nA raised application er-\nror shall be represented by a SOME/IP union: The type field of the union shall be set\nto 0x01. The element of the union with type field set to 0x01 shall be a SOME/IP struct\nwith the following elements in depicted order:\n\u000f\nan\nuint64\nrepresenting the\nApApplicationErrorDomain\n.\nvalue\n, to which\nthe raised\nApApplicationError\nbelongs (\nApApplicationError\n.\nerrorDo-\nmain\n).\n\u000f\nan\nint32\nrepresenting the\nApApplicationError\n.\nerrorCode\n, which is repre-\nsented on binding level as\nara::core::ErrorCode::Value()\n."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P99_256",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10313",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 99,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nAdditionally, following SOME/IP Transformation property values for the\nApApplica-\ntionError\nare hard coded:\n\u000f\nsizeOfUnionLengthField\n/=\n32bit\n\u000f\nsizeOfUnionTypeSelectorField\n/=\n8bit\n\u000f\nsizeOfStructLengthField\n/=\n16bit\n\u000f\nsizeOfStringLengthField\n/=\n16bit\n\u000f\nbyte-Order=\nnetwork-byte-order(big endian)\n\u000f\nTLV for struct=no\n\u000f\nalignment=no\n\u000f\nString encoding=\nUTF-8\n\u000f\nString BOM=\ntrue\n\u000f\nString null-termination=\ntrue\nc\n(RS_SOMEIP_00014)\n[SWS_CM_10313] Checks for a received SOME/IP response message\nd\nUpon re-\nception of a SOME/IP response message the following checks shall be conducted:\n\u000f\nVerify that the Protocol Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00052]) is set to 0x01.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Length (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00042]) is larger than 7.\n\u000f\nUse the Message Type (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]) which is set to either\nRE-\nSPONSE\n(0x80) or\nERROR\n(0x81) to determine that the received SOME/IP mes-\nsage is actually a SOME/IP response message or error response message.\n\u000f\nUse the Service ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) and the\nserviceInter-\nfaceId\nattribute of the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement in\nthe Manifest to determine the right\nServiceInterface\n.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Method ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) matches the\nmetho-\ndId\nattribute of one of the\nSomeipMethodDeployment\ns of the\nSomeipSer-\nviceInterfaceDeployment\n.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Interface Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00053]) matches\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nserviceInterfaceVersion\n.\nmajorVersion\n.\n\u000f\nVerify that the Client ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00702]) matches the client from the\ncorresponding SOME/IP request message (see [SWS_CM_10301]).\n\u000f\nThe Session ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00703]) matches the client from the corre-\nsponding SOME/IP request message (see [SWS_CM_10301]).\nIf any of the above checks fails the received SOME/IP response message shall\nbe discarded and the incident shall be logged (if logging is enabled for the\n99 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nara::com\nimplementation).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00212, RS_-\nCM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00007, RS_SOMEIP_00003, RS_SOMEIP_00012, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00019, RS_SOMEIP_00021, RS_SOMEIP_00025, RS_SOMEIP_00041,\nRS_SOMEIP_00008, RS_SOMEIP_00014)\n[SWS_CM_10314] Identifying the right method\nd\nUsing the Service ID (see [PRS_-\nSOMEIP_00245]) and the\nserviceInterfaceId\nattribute of the\nSomeipServi-\nceInterfaceDeployment\nelement as well as the Method ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_-\n00245]) and the\nmethodId\nattribute of the\nSomeipMethodDeployment\ns of the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n, the right method shall be identified.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_-\n00006, RS_SOMEIP_00007, RS_SOMEIP_00021)\n[SWS_CM_10315] Discarding orphaned responses\nd\nIn case the method call has\nbeen canceled according to [SWS_CM_00194] in the mean time, the received respon-\nse/error messages of the canceled methods shall be ignored.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_-\nCM_00212, RS_CM_00213)\n[SWS_CM_10357] Distinguishing errors from normal responses\nd\nThe Message\nType (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]) and the Return Code (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00058]\nand [PRS_SOMEIP_00191]) of the SOME/IP message shall be used to determine\nwhether the received SOME/IP message is a normal response (Message Type set\nto\nRESPONSE\n(0x80)\nand\nReturn Code set to 0x0) or an error response (Message Type\nset to\nERROR\n(0x81)\nor\nReturn Code set to a value different from 0x0)\n2\nw.r.t. the further\nprocessing according to [SWS_CM_10316], [SWS_CM_10358], [SWS_CM_10429],\n[SWS_CM_10430] and [SWS_CM_10317].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_SOMEIP_00008)\n[SWS_CM_10316] Deserializing the payload - normal response messages\nd\nBased\non the method determined according to [SWS_CM_10314] the Payload of the response\nmessage shall be deserialized according to the SOME/IP serialization rules.  There-\nfore the\nArgumentDataPrototype\ns with\ndirection\nset to\ninout\nand\nout\nshall\nbe deserialized according to their order.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_-\n00213, RS_SOMEIP_00007, RS_SOMEIP_00028)\nThe SOME/IP serialization rules\nare explained in section 7.4.1.9.\n[SWS_CM_10442] Failures during deserialization of response messages\nd\nIn\ncase of failures during deserialization of response messages, the\nara::com\nim-\nplementation shall make the\nFuture\nreturned by the function call operator (\nop-\nerator()\n) of the respective\nMethod\nclass (see [SWS_CM_00196]) ready accord-\ning to [SWS_CM_10440].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00007, RS_SOMEIP_00028)\n[SWS_CM_10358] Identifying the right application error in a message with Mes-\nsage Type set to\nRESPONSE\n(0x80)\nd\nIf the Return Code (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00058]"

      "source_element": "SWS_CM_00196",
