      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P138_300",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10390",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 138,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nThe following trigger options shall be supported:\n\u000f\na message needs to be transmitted for which the\nudpCollectionTrigger\nis\nset to\nalways\n.\n\u000f\nthe\nudpCollectionBufferTimeout\nis reached for one of the message al-\nready aggregated in the buffer.\n\u000f\nthe buffer size defined by the attribute\nudpCollectionBufferSizeThresh-\nold\nis reached.\n\u000f\nadding the\nmethod\nresponse or\nevent\nto the buffer would lead to a message\nlarger than the maximum possible size (e.g. MTU size). In this case the actual\nbuffer shall be triggered before handling the new event or method response.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00004)\nBased on [SWS_CM_10390]:\n[SWS_CM_80020]\n{DRAFT}\nConfiguration of a data accumulation on a\nRe-\nquiredSomeipServiceInstance\nfor transmission over UDP\nd\nFor a\nRequired-\nSomeipServiceInstance\nall\nmethod\nrequests for which the\nudpCollection-\nTrigger\nis set to\nnever\nshall be aggregated in a buffer until a trigger arrives that\nstarts the data transmission.\nThe following trigger options shall be supported:\n\u000f\na message needs to be transmitted for which the\nudpCollectionTrigger\nis\nset to\nalways\n.\n\u000f\nthe\nudpCollectionBufferTimeout\nis reached for one of the message al-\nready aggregated in the buffer.\n\u000f\nthe buffer size defined by the attribute\nudpCollectionBufferSizeThresh-\nold\nis reached.\n\u000f\nadding the\nmethod\nrequest or\nevent\nto the buffer would lead to a message\nlarger than the maximum possible size (e.g. MTU size). In this case the actual\nbuffer shall be triggered before handling the new event or method response.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00004)\nIn the following sections the term \"sending of a message shall be requested\" will\nbe used to describe the fact that the sending of the message is requested but\nmay be deferred due to data accumulation for UDP data transmission according to\n[SWS_CM_10388], [SWS_CM_80019], and [SWS_CM_80020].\n7.4.2.1.3 Execution context of message reception actions\nThe section 7.4.1.4 is fully applicable to the signal-based network binding.\n138 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n7.4.2.1.4 Handling Events\nBased on [SWS_CM_10287]:\n[SWS_CM_80021]\n{DRAFT}\nConditions for sending of an event message\nd\nThe\nsending of an event message shall be requested by invoking the\nSend\nmethod of\nthe respective\nEvent\nclass (see [SWS_CM_00162] and [SWS_CM_90437]) if there\nis at least one active subscriber and the offer of the service containing the event has\nnot been stopped (either because the TTL contained in the SOME/IP OfferService\nmessage (see [SWS_CM_00203]) has expired or because the\nStopOfferService\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00111]) of the\nServiceSkeleton\nclass has been called).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_00005, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00017, RS_CM_00004)\nBased on [SWS_CM_10288]:\n[SWS_CM_80022]\n{DRAFT}\nTransport protocol for sending of an event message\nd\nThe event message shall be transmitted using UDP if the threshold defined by the\nmulticastThreshold\nattribute of the\nSomeipProvidedEventGroup\nthat is aggre-\ngated by the\nProvidedSomeipServiceInstance\nin the role\neventGroup\nin the\nManifest has been reached (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00134]).\nThe event message shall be transmitted using the transport protocol defined by\nthe attribute\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\neventDeployment\n.\ntrans-\nportProtocol\nin the Manifest if this threshold has not been reached (see [PRS_-\nSOMEIPSD_00802]).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00010, RS_CM_00004)\nBased on [SWS_CM_10289]:\n[SWS_CM_80023]\n{DRAFT}\nSource of an event message\nd\nThe event message\nshall use the unicast IP address and port taken from the IPv4/v6 Endpoint Option\n(see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00307] and [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00315]) of the SOME/IP Of-\nferService message ([SWS_CM_00203]) as source address and source port for the\ntransmission.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_-\n00042, RS_CM_00004)\nBased on [SWS_CM_10290]:\n[SWS_CM_80024]\n{DRAFT}\nDestination of an event message\nd\nThe event message\nshall use the multicast IP address and the port taken from       "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nthe transmission if this threshold has not been reached (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_-\n00134]). If the\nserializer\nis defined as\nsomeip serializer\nthe SOME/IP event\nhandling applies.\nBased on [SWS_CM_10291]:\n[SWS_CM_80025]\n{DRAFT}\nContent of the SOME/IP serialized event message\nd\nIf\nSomeipEventDeployment\n.\nserializer\nis set to\nsomeip\nthen\nthe entries in the SOME/IP serialized event message shall be as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Service ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Manifest\nwhere the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\nser-\nviceInterfaceId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Method ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Mani-\nfest where the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\neventDeployment\n.\neventId\nby adding 0x8000 to the\neventDeployment\n.\neventId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Length (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00042]) shall be set to the length of the seri-\nalized payload in units of bytes incremented by 8 (second part of the SOME/IP\nheader that is covered by the Length)\n\u000f\nThe Client ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00702]) is unused for event messages (ac-\ncording to [PRS_SOMEIP_00702]) and thus shall be set to 0x0000.\n\u000f\nIn case of inactive Session Handling, see [SWS_CM_10240], the Session ID (see\n[PRS_SOMEIP_00703]) is unused for event messages and thus shall be set to\n0x0000 (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00932]) and [PRS_SOMEIP_00925]).\nIn case of active Session Handling, see [SWS_CM_10240], the Session ID\nis used for event messages and thus shall be incremented (with proper wrap\naround) upon every transmission of an event message (see [PRS_SOMEIP_-\n00933], [PRS_SOMEIP_00934], [PRS_SOMEIP_00521], and [PRS_SOMEIP_-\n00925]).\n\u000f\nThe Protocol Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00052]) shall be set to 0x01.\n\u000f\nThe Interface Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00053]) shall be derived from the\nManifest where the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines\nthe\nserviceInterfaceVersion\n.\nmajorVersion\n.\n\u000f\nThe Message Type (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]) serialization, see chapter 7.4.1.7.\n7.4.2.1.7 Handling Fields\nBased on [SWS_CM_10319]:\n[SWS_CM_80063]\n{DRAFT}\nConditions for sending of an event message\nd\nThe\nsending of an event message shall be requested by invoking the\nUpdate\nmethod\nof the respective\nField\nclass (see [SWS_CM_00119]) or if the\nFuture\nreturned\nby the\nSetHandler\nregistered with\nRegisterSetHandler\n(see [SWS_CM_00116])\nbecomes ready if there is at least one active subscriber and the offer of the ser-\nvice containing the event has not been stopped (either because the TTL contained in\nthe SOME/IP OfferService message (see [SWS_CM_00203]) has expired or because\nthe\nStopOfferService\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00111]) of the\nServiceSkeleton\nclass has been called).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00009, RS_SOMEIP_00005, RS_SOMEIP_00017, RS_SOMEIP_00018,\nRS_CM_00004)\nBased on [SWS_CM_10320]:\n[SWS_CM_80064]\n{DRAFT}\nTransport protocol for sending of an event message\nd\nThe event message shall be transmitted using UDP if the threshold defined by the\nmulticastThreshold\nattribute of the\nSomeipProvidedEventGroup\nthat is aggre-\ngated by the\nProvidedSomeipServiceInstance\nin the role\neventGroup\nin the\nManifest has been reached (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00134]).\nThe event message shall be transmitted using the transport protocol defined by the\nattribute\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nfieldDeployment\n.\nnotifier\n.\ntransportProtocol\nin the Manifest if this threshold has not been reached (see\n[PRS_SOMEIPSD_00802]).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004,\nRS_SOMEIP_00009, RS_SOMEIP_00010, RS_CM_00004)\n147 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P148_310",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10321",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 148,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nBased on [SWS_CM_10321]:\n[SWS_CM_80065]\n{DRAFT}\nSource of an event message\nd\nThe source address and\nthe source port of the event message shall set according to [SWS_CM_80023].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_00009, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00042, RS_CM_00004)\nBased on [SWS_CM_10322]:\n[SWS_CM_80066]\n{DRAFT}\nDestination of an event message\nd\nThe destination\naddress and the destination port of the event message shall be set according\nto [SWS_CM_80024].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00009, RS_SOMEIP_00042, RS_CM_00004)\nBased on the\nserviceInterfaceId\nand\neventId\nthe respective field notifier is de-\ntermined. If the\nserializer\nis defined as\nsomeip serializer\nthe SOME/IP seri-\nalized event handling applies.\nBased on [SWS_CM_10323]:\n[SWS_CM_80067]\n{DRAFT}\nContent of the SOME/IP serialized event message\nd\nIf\nSomeipEventDeployment\n.\nserializer\nis set to\nsomeip\nthen\nthe entries in the SOME/IP serialized event message shall be as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Service ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Manifest\nwhere the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\nser-\nviceInterfaceId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Method ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Mani-\nfest where the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\neventDeployment\n.\neventId\nby adding 0x8000 to the\neventDeployment\n.\neventId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Length (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00042]) shall be set to the length of the seri-\nalized payload in units of bytes incremented by 8 (second part of the SOME/IP\nheader that is covered by the Length)\n\u000f\nThe Client ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00702]) is unused for event messages (ac-\ncording to [PRS_SOMEIP_00702]) and thus shall be set to 0x0000.\n\u000f\nIn case of inactive Session Handling the Session ID (see [SWS_CM_10240])\nthe Session ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00703]) is unused for event messages and\nthus shall be set to 0x0000 (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00932]) and [PRS_SOMEIP_-\n00925]).\nIn case of active Session Handling, see [SWS_CM_10240], the Session ID\nis used for event messages and thus shall be incremented (with proper wrap\naround) upon every transmission of an event message (see [PRS_SOMEIP_-\n00933], [PRS_SOMEIP_00934], [PRS_SOMEIP_00521], and [PRS_SOMEIP_-\n00925]).\n\u000f\nThe Protocol Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00052]) shall be set to 0x01.\n148 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P149_311",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_80068",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 149,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\nThe Interface Version (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00053]) shall be derived from the\nManifest where the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines\nthe\nserviceInterfaceVersion\n.\nmajorVersion\n.\n\u000f\nThe Message Type (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]) shall be set to\nNOTIFICATION\n(0x02).\n\u000f\nThe Return Code (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00058] and [PRS_SOMEIP_00191]) is\nunused for event messages and thus (according to [PRS_SOMEIP_00925]) shall\nbe set to\nE_OK\n(0x00).\n\u000f\nThe Payload shall contain the serialized payload (i.e., the serialized\nField\ncom-\nposed by the\nServiceInterface\nin role\nfield\n) according to the SOME/IP\nserialization rules.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00041, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00022, RS_SOMEIP_00003, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_00009,\nRS_CM_00004)\nIf the\nserializer\nis defined as\nsignalBased\nthe signal-based event handling ap-\nplies. As the message containing the signal-based payload is going to be routed to the\nClassic platform (without the\nSOME/IP Transformation\n) the header just contains\nthe\nMessage Id\n(i.e.\nServiceID\nand\nMethod ID\n) (see [SWS_CM_80068]).\n[SWS_CM_80068]\n{DRAFT}\nContent of the signal-based serialized event message\nd\nIf\nSomeipEventDeployment\n.\nserializer\nis set to\nsignalBased\nthen\nthe entries in the signal-based serialized event message shall be as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Service ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Manifest\nwhere the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\nser-\nviceInterfaceId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Method ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00245]) shall be derived from the Mani-\nfest where the\nSomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\neventDeployment\n.\neventId\nby adding 0x8000 to the\neventDeployment\n.\neventId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Length (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00042]) shall be set to the length of the serial-\nized payload in units of bytes\n\u000f\nThe Payload shall contain the serialized payload (i.e., the serialized\nVari-\nableDataPrototype\ncomposed by the\nServiceInterface\nin role\nevent\n)\naccording to the signal-service-translation serialization rules defined in TPS-\nManifestSpecification [5].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00041, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00022, RS_SOMEIP_00003, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_00009,\nRS_CM_00004)\nIf the\nserializer\nis defined as\nsomeip serializer\nthe SOME/IP serialized event\nhandling applies.\n149 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P150_312",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10324",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 150,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nBased on [SWS_CM_10324]:\n[SWS_CM_80069]\n{DRAFT}\nChecks for a received SOME/IP serialized event mes-\nsage\nd\nIf\nSomeipEventDeployment\n.\nserializer\nis set to\nsomeip\nthen\nupon reception of a SOME/IP serialized event message the checks defined in\n[SWS_CM_80027] shall be conducted.\nIf any of the above checks fails the received SOME/IP serialized event message shall\nbe discarded and the incident shall be logged (if logging is enabled for the\nara::\ncom\nimplementation).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00019, RS_-\nSOMEIP_00022, RS_SOMEIP_00003, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_00009,\nRS_SOMEIP_00014, RS_CM_00004)\nIf the\nserializer\nis defined as\nsignalBased\nthe signal-based event handling ap-\nplies. As the message containing the signal-based payload is coming from the Classic\nplatform (without the\nSOME/IP Transformation\n) the header just contains the\nMes-\nsage Id\n(i.e.\nServiceID\nand\nMethod ID\n) (see [SWS_CM_80070]).\n[SWS_CM_80070]\n{DRAFT}\nChecks for a received signal-based event message\nd\nIf\nSomeipEventDeployment\n.\nserializer\nis set to\nsignalBased\nthen\nupon reception of a signal-based event message the checks defined in\n[SWS_CM_80028] shall be conducted.\nIf any of the above checks fails the received signal-based event message shall be\ndiscarded and the incident shall be logged (if logging is enabled for the\nara::com\nimplementation).\nc\n(RS_CM_00004)\n[SWS_CM_10325] applies.\nBased on [SWS_CM_10380]:\n[SWS_CM_80072]\n{DRAFT}\nSilently discarding event messages for unsubscribed\nevents\nd\nIf the event identified according to [SWS_CM_10325] does not have an active\nsubscription because the\nSubscribe\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00141]) of the spe-\ncific\nField\nclass of the\nServiceProxy\nclass has not been called, or the\nUnsub-\nscribe\nmethod (see [SWS_CM_00151]) of the specific\nField\nclass of the\nServi-\nceProxy\nclass has been called, or the TTL of the SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup\nmessage (see [SWS_CM_00205]) has expired, then the received event message shall\nbe silently discarded (i.e., [SWS_CM_80074], [SWS_CM_80101], [SWS_CM_10327],\nand [SWS_CM_10328] shall\nnot\nbe performed).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00203,\nRS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_00009, RS_CM_00004)\n[SWS_CM_10328] applies.\nBased on [SWS_CM_10326]:\n[SWS_CM_80074]\n{DRAFT}\nDeserializing the SOME/IP serialized payload\nd\nIf\nSomeipEventDeployment\n.\nserializer\nis set to\nsomeip\nthen\nbased on the event determined according to [SWS_CM_10325] the Payload of the\n150 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nSOME/IP serialized event message (i.e., the serialized\nField\ncomposed by the\nSer-\nviceInterface\nin RS_CM_00004)\nNote:\n[SWS_CM_80074] supports the mix of\nsignal-based\nand\nSOME/IP\ncommu-\nnication use case defined in [SWS_CM_10174].\n[SWS_CM_80075]\n{DRAFT}\nDeserializing the signal-based       "source_element": "SWS_CM_10348",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 152,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_10348] does not apply to Signal-Based SOME/IP network binding.\n[SWS_CM_10444] does not apply to Signal-Based SOME/IP network binding.\n[SWS_CM_10349] does not apply to Signal-Based SOME/IP network binding.\n[SWS_CM_10350] applies.\n[SWS_CM_10363] applies.\n7.4.2.1.8 Serialization of Payload\nThe serialization technology is defined by the attribute\nSomeipEventDeployment\n.\nserializer\n. If the attribute is set to\nsignalBased\nthen the signal-service-\ntranslation is responsible for the handling of the serialization. If the attribute is set\nto\nsomeip\nthen the SOME/IP serializer (see section 7.4.1.9) is responsible for the\nhandling of the serialization.\n[SWS_CM_80100]\n{DRAFT}\nSOME/IP serialization of signal-based network bind-\ning\nd\nIf the attribute\nSomeipEventDeployment\n.\nserializer\nis set to\nsomeip\nthen\nthe serialization of the payload shall be based on the SOME/IP serialization rules.\nc\n(RS_CM_00004)\nNote: SOME/IP serialization rules are defined in section 7.4.1.9.\n[SWS_CM_80101]\n{DRAFT}\nSignal-based serialization\nd\nIf the attribute\nSomeipEventDeployment\n.\nserializer\nis set to\nsignalBased\nthen\nthe serialization of the payload shall be based on the definition of the\nSer-\nviceInstanceToSignalMapping\ndefined for the signal-service-translation in\nTPS-ManifestSpecification [5].\nc\n(RS_CM_00004)\n[SWS_CM_80102]\n{DRAFT}\nIgnoring not mapped elements\nd\nTo allow migration the\ndeserialization shall ignore signals which are not subject to\nServiceInstance-\nToSignalMapping\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00202)\n[SWS_CM_80103]\n{DRAFT}\nDeserializing incomplete data belonging to a field\nd\nIf\nless data than expected shall be deserialized and the data to be deserialized belong\nto a\nField\n, the\ninitValue\nshall be used if it is defined. Otherwise the data shall\nbe completely discarded and the incident shall be logged (if logging is enabled for the\nara::com\nimplementation).\nc\n(RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00202)\n[SWS_CM_80104]\n{DRAFT}\nDeserializing more data than expected\nd\nIf more data\nthan expected shall be deserialized, the unexpected data shall be discarded. The\nknown fraction shall be considered.\nc\n(RS_CM_00004)\n152 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P153_315",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_80501",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 153,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n7.4.2.2 Signal-Based Static Network binding\nThe\nSignal-Based Static\nnetwork binding is enabled when a\nService-\nInstanceToSignalMapping\nrefers to a\nProvidedUserDefinedServiceIn-\nstance\nor\nRequiredUserDefinedServiceInstance\nof\ncategory SIGNAL-\nBASED_WITH_HEADER\nor\nSIGNALBASED_NO_HEADER\n.\nPlease note that there is currently no static\nara::com\nAPI optimization defined, thus\nit is expected that the adaptive application, which interacts with a\nServiceInter-\nface\n, uses the same steps as in any other service oriented interaction (i.e. calling\nOfferService(), FindService(), Subscribe(), ...).\nThe general approach is:\nFor a\nProvidedUserDefinedServiceInstance\nthe connection is established in a\nUDP / TCP Server role.\nFor a\nRequiredUserDefinedServiceInstance\nthe connection is established in a\nUDP / TCP Client role.\n7.4.2.2.1 Service Discovery\n[SWS_CM_80501]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of Offer Service (\nSignal-Based Static\nnetwork binding)\nd\nWhen instructed to\noffer\na service instance which is\nmapped to a\nProvidedUserDefinedServiceInstance\nof\ncategory SIGNAL-\nBASED_WITH_HEADER\nor\nSIGNALBASED_NO_HEADER\n, then the\nSignal-Based\nStatic\nnetwork binding shall create / use a socket for each entry in the\nremotePeers\nlist. Each connection is defined by the\nlocalUdpPortNumber\nor\nlocalTcpPort-\nNumber\nand one element out of the\nremotePeers\nlist. If a connection with identical\ncredentials already exists then this existing connection shall be used.\nIf a\nlocalUdpPortNumber\nis defined then each connection is created using the UDP\nprotocol and bound to the listed\nremotePeers\n.\nIf a\nlocalTcpPortNumber\nis defined then each connection is created using the TCP\nprotocol and is listening for client connections.\nc\n(RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204)\n[SWS_CM_80512]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of Stop Offer Service (\nSignal-Based\nStatic\nnetwork binding)\nd\nWhen instructed to\nstop offering\na service instance which\nis mapped to a\nProvidedUserDefinedServiceInstance\nof\ncategory SIG-\nNALBASED_WITH_HEADER\nor\nSIGNALBASED_NO_HEADER\n, then the\nSignal-Based\nStatic\nnetwork binding shall check:\n\u000f\nIf this is the last service instance which uses the respective connection then this\nconnection shall be closed.\n\u000f\nIf there are still other service instance using this connection then the connection\nshall be kept open.\nc\n(RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204)\n153 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P154_316",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_80502",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 154,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_80502]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of Find Service (\nSignal-Based Static\nnetwork binding)\nd\nWhen instructed to\nfind\na service instance which is\nmapped to a\nRequiredUserDefinedServiceInstance\nof\ncategory SIGNAL-\nBASED_WITH_HEADER\nor\nSIGNALBASED_NO_HEADER\n, then the\nSignal-Based\nStatic\nnetwork binding shall immediately return a\nara::com::ServiceHandle-\nContainer\nwith information about the static connection:\n\u000f\nlocalUdpPortNumber\nor\nlocalTcpPortNumber\n\u000f\ninformation about the\nEthernetCommunicationConnector\n(VLAN) where\nthe connection shall be applied to\n\u000f\na\nmulticastIpAddress\nwhere the events will be consumed in case of multicast\nreception\n\u000f\nremotePeer\ninformation of the remote sender of the data (IP-Address and Port\nnumber)\nc\n(RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204)\n[SWS_CM_80503]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of Subscribe Service (\nSignal-Based\nStatic\nnetwork binding)\nd\nWhen instructed to\nsubscribe\nto an event which\nis part of a\nRequiredUserDefinedServiceInstance\nof\ncategory SIGNAL-\nBASED_WITH_HEADER\nor\nSIGNALBASED_NO_HEADER\n, then the\nSignal-Based\nStatic\nnetwork binding shall:\nIf there is not already a socket connection established:\n\u000f\nTCP: use the information from the\nara::com::ServiceHandleContainer\ncreate the socket and connect to the server.\n\u000f\nUDP: use the information from the\nara::com::ServiceHandleContainer\ncreate the socket.\nIf there is already a socket connection established: use this socket connection.\nc\n(RS_-\nCM_00004, RS_CM_00204)\n[SWS_CM_80513]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of Unsubscribe Service (\nSignal-Based\nStatic\nnetwork binding)\nd\nWhen instructed to\nun-subscribe\nfrom an event which\nis part of a\nRequiredUserDefinedServiceInstance\nof\ncategory SIGNAL-\nBASED_WITH_HEADER\nor\nSIGNALBASED_NO_HEADER\n, then the\nSignal-Based\nStatic\nnetwork binding shall check:\n\u000f\nIf this is the last service instance which uses the respective connection then this\nconnection shall be closed.\n\u000f\nIf there are still other service instance using this connection then the connection\nshall be kept open.\nc\n(RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204)\n154 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P155_317",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_80505",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 155,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n7.4.2.2.2 Accumulation of messages\n[SWS_CM_80505]\n{DRAFT}\nData accumulation for UDP data transmission (\nSignal-Based Static\nnetwork binding)\nd\nTo allow for the transmission of multi-\nple messages (signal-based events and signal-based field notifiers) within a single\nUDP datagram, data accumulation for UDP data transmission shall be supported.\nc\n(RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204)\n[SWS_CM_80504]\n{DRAFT}\nConfiguration of a data accumulation on a\nRequire-\ndUserDefinedServiceInstance\nfor transmission over UDP (\nSignal-Based\nStatic\nnetwork binding)\nd\nFor a\nProvidedUserDefinedServiceInstance\nof\ncategory SIGNALBASED_WITH_HEADER\nwhich has a\nudpCollectionBuffer-\nSizeThreshold\n> 0 defined, the events and field notifiers where\nudpCollection-\nTrigger\nis set to\nnever\nshall be aggregated in a buffer until a trigger arrives that\nstarts the data transmission.\nThe following trigger options shall be supported:\n\u000f\na message needs to be transmitted for which the\nudpCollectionTrigger\nis\nset to\nalways\n.\n\u000f\nthe\nudpCollectionBufferTimeout\nis reached for one of the messages al-\nready aggregated in the buffer.\n\u000f\nthe buffer size defined by the attribute\nudpCollectionBufferSizeThresh-\nold\nis reached.\n\u000f\nadding the event of field notifier to the buffer would lead to a message larger than\nthe maximum possible size (e.g. MTU size). In this case the actual buffer shall\nbe triggered before handling the new event or field notifier.\nc\n(RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204)\n7.4.2.2.3 Execution context of message reception actions\nThe section 7.4.1.4 is fully applicable to the\nSignal-Based Static\nnetwork binding.\n7.4.2.2.4 Handling Events\n[SWS_CM_80506]\n{DRAFT}\nArbitrary Message Header\nusage for\nSignal-\nBased Static\nnetwork binding messages\nd\nIf a\nProvidedUserDefinedSer-\nviceInstance\nor\nRequiredUserDefinedServiceInstance\nof\ncategory SIG-\nNALBASED_WITH_HEADER\nis defined then each message shall have an\nArbitrary\nMessage Header\n(see [TPS_Manifest]) defined. This message header is composed\nof a 32 bit wide Message ID field and 32 bit wide Message Length field. Both encoded\nin big endian.\n155 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P156_318",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_80507",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 156,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nThe the signal based payload is appended (the Message Length field is used to deter-\nmine how long the payload is in bytes).\nc\n(RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204)\n[SWS_CM_80507]\n{DRAFT}\nNo header option for\nSignal-Based Static\nnetwork\nbinding messages\nd\nIf a\nProvidedUserDefinedServiceInstance\nor\nRequire-\ndUserDefinedServiceInstance\nof\ncategory SIGNALBASED_NO_HEADER\nis de-\nfined then there is no header information standardized and thus the signal based pay-\nload is the only content of the message.\nc\n(RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204)\n7.4.2.2.5 Handling Method Calls\n[SWS_CM_80508]\n{DRAFT}\nNo method support for\nSignal-Based Static\nnet-\nwork binding\nd\nThe\nSignal-Based Static\nnetwork binding does not support meth-\nods.\nc\n(RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204)\n7.4.2.2.6 Handling Fields\n[SWS_CM_80509]\n{DRAFT}\nOnly field notifier support for\nSignal-Based Static\nnetwork binding\nd\nThe\nSignal-Based Static\nnetwork binding only supports the\nfield notifier. Getter or Setter methods are not supported.\nc\n(RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_-\n00204)\n7.4.2.2.7 Serialization of Payload\nIn case of the static signal-service-translation always the signal-service-translation is\nresponsible for the handling of the serialization.\n[SWS_CM_80510]\n{DRAFT}\nIgnoring not mapped elements\nd\nTo allow migration the\ndeserialization shall ignore signals which are not subject to\nServiceInstance-\nToSignalMapping\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00004)\n[SWS_CM_80511]\n{DRAFT}\nDeserializing incomplete data belonging to a field\nd\nIf\nless data than expected shall be deserialized and the data to be deserialized belong\nto a\nField\n, the\ninitValue\nshall be used if it is defined. Otherwise the data shall\nbe completely discarded and the incident shall be logged (if logging is enabled for the\nara::com\nimplementation).\nc\n(RS_CM_00004)\n7.4.3 DDS Network binding\n[SWS_CM_11000] DDS Compliance\nd\nThe DDS network binding shall comply with the\nDDS Minimum Profile defined in [19], the DDS Wire Interoperability protocol (RTPS)\ndefined in [20], and the DDS-XTYPES Minimal Programming Interface and Network\nInteroperability Profiles defined in [21].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, FO_RS_Dds_00001)\n156 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P157_319",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_90500",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 157,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_90500]\n{DRAFT}\nChoice of Service Instance discovery protocol\nd\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\ns and\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\ns provide\na\ndiscoveryType\nattribute permitting the choice between two distinct discovery pro-\ntocols. For a Service Interface Skeleton to be discoverable by a Service Interface Proxy,\nboth shall be configured with the same\ndiscoveryType\nvalue.\nc\n(RS_CM_00101, RS_-\nCM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\nThe\nDomainParticipantUserDataQos\nsetting provides a discovery protocol that\nleverages the USER_DATA QoS policy of DDS Domain Participants, assigning a\npurpose-specific format string to it as described in 7.4.3.1 below. This approach is\nfast and nimble, since no additional DDS Entities beyond Domain Participants need to\nbe created to exercise discovery of Service Instances.\nThe\nTopic\nsetting provides, as described in section 7.4.3.2 below, a discovery proto-\ncol that employs a purpose-specific Topic of a well-defined type to distribute Service\nInstance announcements in a publish-subscribe, instance-based fashion. This pro-\ntocol, although more resource-demanding (DDS entities down to a single DataWriter\nneed to be created for Skeletons, same for a DataReader in Proxies), enhances in-\nteroperability and enables advanced DDS features such as persistence, routing and\ndurability.\n[SWS_CM_90501]\n{DRAFT}\nTopic naming for Domain Participant USER_DATA\nQoS - based Service Instances\nd\nWhen\nDomainParticipantUserDataQos\nis set in the\ndiscoveryType\nattribute for a specific\nDdsProvidedServi-\nceInstance\nor\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\n, the de-facto Topic naming\nscheme for events, triggers, methods and fields is the one described for\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00211, RS_-\nCM_00216, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005)\n7.4.3.1 Service Discovery via Domain Participant USER_DATA QoS policy\n[SWS_CM_11001] Mapping of OfferService method\nd\nWhen instructed to offer a\nService, the DDS Binding shall perform the following operations:\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11002] It shall assign a DDS DomainParticipant to the Service In-\nstance.\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11003] It shall assign a DDS Topic and a DDS DataWriter to ev-\nery\nVariableDataPrototype\ndefined in the\nServiceInterface\nin the role\nevent\n.\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_10550] It shall assign a DDS Topic and a DDS DataWriter to every\nTrigger\ndefined in the\nServiceInterface\nin the role\ntrigger\n.\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11029] It shall assign a DDS Request Topic and a DDS Reply Topic,\nand create their corresponding DDS DataWriter and DataReader, to provide ac-\ncess to all\nClientServerOperation\ns defined in the\nServiceInterface\nthe\nrole\nmethod\n.\n157 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P158_320",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11030",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 158,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11030] It shall assign a DDS Topic and a DDS DataWriter to every\nField\ndefined in the\nServiceInterface\nin the role\nfield\nwith its\nhasNoti-\nfier\nattribute set to\ntrue\n.\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11031] It shall assign a DDS Request Topic and a DDS Reply Topic,\nand create their corresponding DDS DataWriter and DDS DataReader, to provide\naccess to all the\nField\ns defined in the\nServiceInterface\nin the role\nfield\nwith\nhasGetter\nand/or\nhasSetter\nattributes set to\ntrue\nvia getter/setter invo-\ncation.\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_09004] It shall add the Service ID, Service Instance IDs, and\nSer-\nviceInterface\ncontract version to the DDS DomainParticipant's USER_DATA\nQoS Policy.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00005)\n[SWS_CM_11002] Assigning a DDS DomainParticipant to a Service Instance\nd\nThe\nDDS Binding shall assign a DDS DomainParticipant to every Service Instance. The\nconfiguration of the DomainParticipant is described in the TPS_ManifestSpecification:\n\u000f\nThe Domain ID of the DomainParticipant shall be derived from the Manifest,\nwhere the\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\nelement defines the\ndomainId\n.\n\u000f\nThe QoS Profile of the DomainParticipant shall be derived from the Manifest,\nwhere the\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nqosProfile\n.\nBefore creating a new DomainParticipant, the DDS binding shall first look for existing\nDomainParticipants in the current process that match the configuration criteria speci-\nfied above\n3\n. If the search is successful, the binding shall assign the DomainParticipant\nfound to the Service\n4\n; otherwise, the binding shall create a new DomainParticipant\naccording to the desired configuration and assign it to the Service.\nOnce the DomainParticipant is available to the Service Instance, the binding implemen-\ntation shall create a DDS Publisher and a DDS Subscriber to enclose all DataWriters\nand DataReaders associated with the Instance. The Partition QoS of both the DDS\nPublisher and DDS Subscriber shall contain the following partition name:\n\"ara.com://services/<svcId>_<svcInId>\"\nWhere:\n<svcId>\nis the Service Id derived from the Manifest, where the\nDdsServiceInter-\nfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\nserviceInterfaceId\n.\n<svcInId>\nis the Instance Id derived from the Manifest, where the\nDdsProvided-\nServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nserviceInstanceId\n."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P159_321",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11003",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 159,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nPublisher and Subscriber objects may be reused across events and other resources\nprovided by the Service Instance; therefore, they shall not be removed until the enclos-\ning DomainParticipant is destroyed.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00005)\n[SWS_CM_11003] Assigning a DDS Topic and a DDS DataWriter to every\nEvent in the ServiceInterface\nd\nThe DDS binding shall assign a DDS Topic to ev-\nery\nevent\nin the\nServiceInterface\naccording to the mapping rules specified in\n[SWS_CM_11015]. Since these DDS Topics may already be available in the Domain-\nParticipant assigned to the Service Instance (e.g., because a different Service Instance\nassigned to the same DomainParticipant may have created them), the service shall first\nlook for existing Topics in the DomainParticipant matching the required criteria. If the\nsearch is unsuccessful, the DomainParticipant shall create a new DDS Topic to repre-\nsent the\nevent\nas defined in [SWS_CM_11015].\nOnce all DDS Topics representing the\nevent\ns in the\nServiceInterface\nare ready\nfor use, the DomainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance shall create one DDS\nDataWriter of the equivalent Topic per\nevent\nusing the DDS Publisher created in\n[SWS_CM_11002]. The DataWriter shall be configured according to the\nqosProfile\nspecified in the associated\nDdsEventQosProps\n.\nTopic objects may be reused across service instances; therefore, they shall not be re-\nmoved until the enclosing DomainParticipant is destroyed.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_-\n00015)\n[SWS_CM_10550]\n{DRAFT}\nAssigning a DDS Topic and a DDS DataWriter to ev-\nery Trigger in the ServiceInterface\nd\nThe DDS binding shall assign a DDS Topic to\nevery\ntrigger\nin the\nServiceInterface\naccording to the mapping rules specified\nin [SWS_CM_10524]. Since these DDS Topics may already be available in the Do-\nmainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance (e.g., because a different Service\nInstance assigned to the same DomainParticipant may have created them), the ser-\nvice shall first look for existing Topics in the DomainParticipant matching the required\ncriteria. If the search is unsuccessful, the DomainParticipant shall create a new DDS\nTopic to represent the\ntrigger\nas defined in [SWS_CM_10524].\nOnce all DDS Topics representing the\ntrigger\ns in the\nServiceInterface\nare\nready for use, the DomainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance shall create\none DDS DataWriter of the equivalent Topic per\ntrigger\nusing the DDS Publisher\ncreated in [SWS_CM_11002]. The DataWriter shall be configured according to the\nqosProfile\nspecified in the associated\nDdsEventQosProps\nthat in turn refers via\nDdsEventDeployment\nto the\ntrigger\ns.\nTopic objects may be reused across service instances; therefore, they shall not be re-\nmoved until the enclosing DomainParticipant is destroyed.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_-\n00015)\n159 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P160_322",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11029",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 160,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_11029] Assigning a DDS Request and Reply Topic, and DataWriters\nand DataReaders, to the Methods in the ServiceInterface\nd\nThe DDS binding shall\ninstantiate a DDS Service [22] to handle requests to all the\nmethod\ns in the\nServi-\nceInterface\n.\nIn practice, this implies assigning a DDS Request Topic and a DDS Reply Topic to the\nDDS Service that handles those method calls according to the mapping rules spec-\nified in [SWS_CM_11100]. Since these DDS Topics may already be available in the\nDomainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance (e.g., because a different Service\nInstance assigned to the same DomainParticipant may have created them), the service\nshall first look for existing Topics in the DomainParticipant matching the required crite-\nria. If the search is unsuccessful, the DomainParticipant shall create new DDS Request\nand Reply Topics to represent the DDS Service as specified in [SWS_CM_11100].\nOnce the corresponding DDS Request and Reply Topics are ready for use, the Do-\nmainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance shall create:\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11106] A DDS DataReader of the DDS Request Topic to handle re-\nquests using the DDS Subscriber created in [SWS_CM_11002].\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11107] A DDS DataWriter of the DDS Reply Topic to handle replies\nusing the DDS Publisher created in [SWS_CM_11002].\nTopic objects may be reused across service instances; therefore, they shall not be\nremoved until the enclosing DomainParticipant is destroyed.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_-\nCM_00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00015)\nThe handling\nof method calls with DDS is specified in 7.4.3.5.\n[SWS_CM_11030] Assigning a DDS Topic and a DDS DataWriter to every Field\nin the ServiceInterface with its hasNotifier attribute equal to true\nd\nThe DDS\nbinding shall assign a DDS Topic to every\nfield\nin the\nServiceInterface\nwith\nits\nhasNotifier\nattribute set to\ntrue\naccording to the mapping rules specified in\n[SWS_CM_11130]. Since these DDS Topics may already be available in the Domain-\nParticipant assigned to the Service Instance (e.g., because a different Service Instance\nassigned to the same DomainParticipant may have created them), the service shall first\nlook for existing Topics in the DomainParticipant matching the required criteria. If the\nsearch is unsuccessful, the DomainParticipant shall create a new DDS Topic to repre-\nsent the\nfield\nas defined in [SWS_CM_11130].\nOnce all DDS Topics representing the\nfield\ns in the\nServiceInterface\nare ready\nfor use, the DomainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance shall create one DDS\nDataWriter of the equivalent Topic per\nfield\nwith the\nhasNotifier\nattribute set to\ntrue\nusing the DDS Publisher created in [SWS_CM_11002]. The DataWriter shall\nbe configured according to the\nqosProfile\nspecified in the associated\nDdsField-\nQosProps\n.\nTopic objects may be reused across service instances; therefore, they shall not be re-\nmoved until the enclosing DomainParticipant is destroyed.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_-\n00015)\n160 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P161_323",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11031",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 161,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_11031] Assigning a DDS Request and Reply Topic, and DataWriters\nand DataReaders, to the Field Getters/Setters in the ServiceInterface\nd\nThe DDS\nbinding shall instantiate a DDS Service [22] to handle get/set requests to all the\nfield\ns\nin the\nServiceInterface\nwith\nhasGetter\nand/or\nhasSetter\nset to\ntrue\n.\nIn practice, this implies assigning a DDS Request Topic and a DDS Reply Topic to the\nDDS Service according to the mapping rules specified in [SWS_CM_11144]. Since\nthese DDS Topics may already be available in the DomainParticipant assigned to the\nService Instance (e.g., because a different Service Instance assigned to the same Do-\nmainParticipant may have created them), the service shall first look for existing Topics\nin the DomainParticipant matching the required criteria. If the search is unsuccessful,\nthe DomainParticipant shall create new DDS Request and Reply Topics to represent\nthe DDS Service as specified in [SWS_CM_11144].\nOnce the corresponding DDS Request and Reply Topics are ready for use, the Do-\nmainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance shall create:\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11149] A DDS DataReader of the DDS Request Topic to handle re-\nquests using the DDS Subscriber created in [SWS_CM_11002].\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11150] A DDS DataWriter of the DDS Reply Topic to handle replies\nusing the DDS Publisher created in [SWS_CM_11002].\nTopic objects may be reused across service instances; therefore, they shall not be re-\nmoved until the enclosing DomainParticipant is destroyed.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_-\n00015, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\nThe handling of fields with DDS is specified in section\n7.4.3.6.\n[SWS_CM_09004] Adding Service IDs, Service Instance IDs, and ServiceInter-\nface Contract Versions to the DDS DomainParticipant's USER_DATA QoS Policy\nd\nThe binding implementation shall configure the USER_DATA QoS Policy of the DDS\nDomainParticipant associated with the Service Instance to propagate Service IDs, In-\nstance IDs, and\nServiceInterface\ncontract versions, using the native DDS discov-\nery mechanisms defined in [20]. The USER_DATA QoS Policy appends a user-defined\nvalue to the DomainParticipant's discovery messages. This information shall be used\nby ara::com Clients and DDS native applications to identify a DomainParticipant as an\nara::com DomainParticipant that provides one or more Service Instances.\nService IDs, Service Instance IDs, and\nServiceInterface\ncontract versions shall\nbe encoded in the USER_DATA QoS Policy in string format according to the following\npattern:\n\"ara.com://services/<svcId>_<svcInId>-<svcMajVersion>.<svcMinVersion>\n[&<svcId>_<svcInId>-<svcMajVersion>.<svcMinVersion>]\n*\n\"\nWhere:\n<svcId>\nis the Service ID derived from the Manifest, where the\nDdsServiceInter-\nfaceDeployment\nelement defines the\nserviceInterfaceId\n.\n161 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P162_324",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11005",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 162,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n<svcInId>\nis the Instance ID derived from the Manifest, where the\nDdsProvided-\nServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nserviceInstanceId\n.\n<svcMajVersion>\nis derived from the Manifest, where the\nmajorVersion\nelement\nof the\nServiceInterface\ndefines the contract's major version.\n<svcMinVersion>\nis derived from the Manifest, where the\nminorVersion\nelement\nof the\nServiceInterface\ndefines the contract's minor version.\nBecause a DomainParticipant may be associated with one or more Service Instances,\nthe syntax specified above allows appending one or more\n<svcId>_<svcInId>-\n<svcMajVersion>.<svcMinVersion>\npairs to the USER_DATA QoS:\n\u000f\nIf USER_DATA QoS is empty, the binding implementation shall set\nit to\n\"ara.com://services/<svcId>_<svcInId>-<svcMajVersion>.-\n<svcMinVersion>\"\n.\n\u000f\nElse, if USER_DATA QoS is not empty, the binding implementation shall ap-\npend the Service ID and Instance to the current value preceded by an amper-\nsand symbol (i.e.,\n\"&<svcId>_<svcInId>-<svcMajVersion>.<svcMin-\nVersion>\"\n).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00101, RS_CM_00500, RS_CM_00501,\nFO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11005] Mapping of StopOfferService method\nd\nWhen instructed to stop\noffering a Service, the DDS Binding shall perform the following operations:\n\u000f\nIt shall remove the appropriate Service and Instance IDs from the USER_DATA\nQoS Policy of the DDS DomainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance.\n\u000f\nIt shall remove all DDS DataWriters associated with\nevent\ns in the\nServiceIn-\nterface\ncreated in previous calls to the\nOfferService()\nmethod.\n\u000f\nIt shall remove all DDS DataWriters associated with\ntrigger\ns in the\nServi-\nceInterface\ncreated in previous calls to the\nOfferService()\nmethod.\n\u000f\nIt shall remove all DDS DataWriters and DataReaders associated with the\nClientServerOperation\ns defined in the role\nmethod\ncreated in previous\ncalls to the\nOfferService()\nmethod.\n\u000f\nIt shall remove all DDS DataWriters associated with\nfield\ns in the\nServiceIn-\nterface\nwith their\nhasNotifier\nattribute set to\ntrue\ncreated in previous calls\nto the\nOfferService()\nmethod.\n\u000f\nIt shall remove all DDS DataWriters and DataReaders associated with the\nfield\ns in the\nServiceInterface\nwith\nhasGetter\nand/or\nhasSetter\nat-\ntributes set to\ntrue\ncreated in previous calls to the\nOfferService()\nmethod.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00105, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00015, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\n162 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P163_325",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11006",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 163,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_11006] Mapping of FindService method\nd\nWhen instructed to find remote\nServices, the DDS Binding shall perform the following operations:\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11007] It shall look for an existing DDS DomainParticipant capable of\nfinding remote Services Instances. If such DomainParticipant does not exist, the\nDDS binding shall create a new one as specified in [SWS_CM_11008].\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11009] It shall iterate over the list of discovered remote DomainPar-\nticipants and look for those associated with Service Instances that: (1) match the\nfilter criteria specified in the\nFindService()\ncall, (2) have a compatible\nSer-\nviceInterface\ncontract version, and (3) have a\nServiceInterface\ncontract\nversion that is not part of a\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\n.\nblocklisted-\nVersion\n.\n\u000f\nIt shall return a\nHandleType\nobject for every Service Instance that: (1) matches\nthe filter criteria, (2) has a compatible\nServiceInterface\ncontract version, and\n(3) has a\nServiceInterface\ncontract version that is not part of a\nDdsRe-\nquiredServiceInstance\n.\nblocklistedVersion\n. The Handle object shall\ncontain a reference to both the DomainParticipant that was used in the discovery\nphase and the DDS Publisher and Subscriber created to match the partition of\nthe remote service instance (see [SWS_CM_11009]), so that they can be used\nto create the appropriate DataWriters and DataReaders to handle remote com-\nmunication.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11007] Finding a DDS DomainParticipant suitable for performing\nclient-side operations\nd\nThe DDS binding shall provide client-side methods with a\nDDS DomainParticipant capable of discovering and communicating with remote DDS\nDomainParticipants assigned to the requested Service Instance(s). The configuration\nof the DomainParticipant is described in the TPS_ManifestSpecification:\n\u000f\nThe Domain ID of the DomainParticipant shall be derived from the Manifest,\nwhere the\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\nelement defines the\ndomainId\n.\n\u000f\nThe QoS Profile of the DomainParticipant shall be derived from the Manifest,\nwhere the\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nqosProfile\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11008] Creating a DDS DomainParticipant suitable for perform-\ning client-side operations\nd\nTo create a DomainParticipant capable of discovering\nand communicating with remote DDS DomainParticipants assigned to Service In-\nstances, the binding implementation shall use the configuration parameters in the\nTPS_ManifestSpecification described in [SWS_CM_11007].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_-\nCM_00200, RS_CM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_-\nDds_00008)\n163 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P164_326",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11009",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 164,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_11009] Discovering remote Service Instances through DDS Domain-\nParticipants\nd\nDDS DomainParticipants created or retrieved in the context of Ser-\nvice Discovery are responsible for discovering remote DomainParticipants assigned\nto ara::com Service Instances.\nTo retrieve the list of discovered Service Instances, the DDS binding shall iterate first\nthe list of remote DomainParticipants the DomainParticipant has discovered so far.\nThis shall be done by calling\nread()\non the DomainParticipant's built-in DataReader\nfor the\nDCPSParticipant\nTopic.\nDCPSParticipant\nis a standard DDS Topic de-\nfined in [20] that DomainParticipants use to inform other DomainParticipants of their\npresence in the network. Among other things,\nDCPSParticipant\nTopics propagate\nthe DomainParticipant's USER_DATA QoS Policy; therefore, these messages provide\nall the necessary information to identify remote DomainParticipants associated with\nara::com Service Instances.\nThe DDS binding shall analyze the content of the USER_DATA QoS of each remote Do-\nmainParticipant and check whether they are associated with Service Instances match-\ning the following criteria:\nIf\nrequiredServiceInstanceId\nis set to ALL, the binding shall return a new han-\ndle for each service instance found in remote DomainParticipants' USER_DATA QoS\naccording to the following pattern:\n\"ara.com://services/.\n*\n<svcId>.\n*\n\"\nElse, if\nrequiredServiceInstanceId\nis set to any value other than ALL, the bind-\ning shall return a new handle for every service instance found in remote DomainPar-\nticipants' USER_DATA QoS according to the following pattern:\n\"ara.com://services/.\n*\n<svcId>_<reqSvcInId>.\n*\n\"\nWhere:\n<svcId>\nis the corresponding\nserviceInterfaceId\n.\n<reqSvcInId>\nis the corresponding\nrequiredServiceInstanceId\n.\nIn either case, before returning new handles the binding implementation shall evaluate\nthe\nServiceInterface\ncontract version for the corresponding Service Instance in\nthe content of the USER_DATA QoS. The binding shall return a new handle only if:\n1. The\nServiceInterface\ncontract version of the discovered service instance is\ncompatible with the\nserviceInterfaceDeployment\nversion of the\nDdsRe-\nquiredServiceInstance\naccording to [RS_CM_00501].\n2. The\nServiceInterface\ncontract version is not part of any\nDdsRequiredSer-\nviceInstance\n.\nblocklistedVersion\n, according to [RS_CM_00701].\nBefore returning new handles, the binding implementation shall ensure that the Do-\nmainParticipant used in the discovery phase has one DDS Publisher and one DDS\n164 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P165_327",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11002",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 165,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nSubscriber per service instance found matching the filter criteria\n5\n. The Partition QoS\nof both DDS Publisher and DDS Subscriber shall contain the following partition name\nto match the partition in which the DataReaders and DataWriters associated with the\nremote service instance are operating (in consonance with [SWS_CM_11002]):\n\"ara.com://services/<svcId>_<reqSvcInId>\"\nIf the binding implementation does not find a DDS Publisher with the aforementioned\nrequirements, it shall create a new one and configure the Publisher's Partition QoS with\nthe partition name defined above. Likewise, if it does not find a DDS Subscriber with\nthose requirements, it shall create a new one and configure it accordingly.\nPublisher and Subscriber objects may be reused across proxies associated with a\nremote service instance; therefore, they shall not be removed until the enclosing Do-\nmainParticipant is destroyed.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00008, RS_CM_00501, RS_CM_00701)\n[SWS_CM_11010] Mapping of StartFindService method\nd\nWhen instructed to start\na continuous service search, the DDS Binding shall perform the following operations:\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11007] It shall look for an existing DDS DomainParticipant capable of\nfinding remote Service Instances. If such DomainParticipant does not exist, the\nDDS binding shall create it as specified in [SWS_CM_11008].\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11011] It shall define a DDS BuiltinParticipantListener capable of call-\ning the given\nFindServiceHandler\nupon the occurrence of any of the following\nevents:\n1. A remote DomainParticipant assigned to a matching Service is discovered.\n2. A remote DomainParticipant assigned to a matching Service does not con-\ntain the service anymore (i.e., any time a remote DomainParticipant stopped\noffering a matching Service by removing it from its USER_DATA QoS).\n3. A remote DomainParticipant assigned to a matching Service ceases\nto exist (i.e., the instance state is either\nNOT_ALIVE_DISPOSED\nor\nNOT_ALIVE_NO_WRITERS\n).\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11012] It shall bind the defined BuiltinParticipantListener to the Do-\nmainParticipant.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11011] Defining a DDS BuiltinParticipantListener\nd\nThe DDS Binding\nimplementation shall define a\nBuiltinParticipantListener\nclass to handle noti-\nfications whenever a remote DomainParticipant is discovered. This class shall derive"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P166_328",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11012",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 166,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nfrom the standard\nDataReaderListener\nclass [19], specifying that the data type\nof the samples to be handled is\nParticipantBuiltinTopicData\nthe data type\nassociated with the built-in DataReader for samples of\nDCPSParticipant\nTopic [20].\nBuiltinParticipantListener\nshall implement the following methods according\nto the specified instructions:\n\u000f\nA Constructor that takes as a parameter references to a\nFindServiceHan-\ndler\nand a\nrequiredServiceInstanceId\n. These references shall be stored\nin member variables so that they can be used by subsequent executions of\non_data_available()\nwhich is the method the listener calls every time a\nnew DomainParticipant is discovered.\n\u000f\nAn\non_data_available()\nmethod that calls\nFindServiceHandler\nus-\ning the value of the member variable\nrequiredServiceInstanceId\n. If\nthe returned\nServiceHandleContainer\ncontains more than one element,\non_data_available()\nshall invoke\nFindServiceHandler\nand pass the\ncontainer as a parameter; otherwise the method shall return and perform no\nfurther action.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11012] Binding a BuiltinParticipantListener to a DDS DomainPartici-\npant\nd\nTo bind a\nBuiltinParticipantListener\nto a DDS DomainParticipant, the\nDDS binding implementation shall create a new\nBuiltinParticipantListener\nobject (see [SWS_CM_11011]) passing\nFindServiceHandler\nand\nrequiredSer-\nviceInstanceId\nto the listener's constructor. Then service shall then bind the newly\ncreated listener to the DomainParticipant using the\nset_listener()\nmethod with\nStatusMask = DATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n6\n.\nThe BuiltinParticipantListener shall be removed when the enclosing DomainParticipant\nis destroyed.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001,\nFO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11013] Mapping of StopFindService method\nd\nWhen instructed to stop a\ncontinuous service search initiated by a previous call to\nStartFindService()\n, the\nDDS Binding shall perform the following operations:\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11007] It shall look for an existing DDS DomainParticipant capable\nof finding remote Service Instances. If such DomainParticipant does not exist,\nStopFindService()\nshall return and perform no further action.\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11014] It shall unbind the\nBuiltinParticipantListener\nfrom\nthe retrieved DDS DomainParticipant\n7\n."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P167_329",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11014",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 167,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11014] Unbinding a BuiltinParticipantListener from a DDS Domain-\nParticipant\nd\nWhen instructed to unbind a\nBuiltinParticipantListener\nfrom\na DDS DomainParticipant, the DDS binding implementation service shall invoke\nthe DomainParticipant's\nset_listener()\nmethod to disable the listener. In that\ncase,\nset_listener()\nshall be called with\nStatusMask = STATUS_MASK_NONE\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00008)\n7.4.3.2 Service Discovery via Topic\n[SWS_CM_90502]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of OfferService method\nd\nWhen instructed to\noffer a Service, the DDS Binding shall perform the following operations:\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_90503] It shall assign a DDS DomainParticipant to the Service In-\nstance.\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_90504] It shall assign a DDS Topic and a DDS DataWriter to ev-\nery\nVariableDataPrototype\ndefined in the\nServiceInterface\nin the role\nevent\n.\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_90505] It shall assign a DDS Request Topic and a DDS Reply Topic,\nand create their corresponding DDS DataWriter and DataReader, to provide ac-\ncess to all\nClientServerOperation\ns defined in the\nServiceInterface\nthe\nrole\nmethod\n.\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_90506] It shall assign a DDS Topic and a DDS DataWriter to every\nField\ndefined in the\nServiceInterface\nin the role\nfield\nwith its\nhasNoti-\nfier\nattribute set to\ntrue\n.\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_90507] It shall assign a DDS Request Topic and a DDS Reply Topic,\nand create their corresponding DDS DataWriter and DDS DataReader, to provide\naccess to all the\nField\ns defined in the\nServiceInterface\nin the role\nfield\nwith\nhasGetter\nand/or\nhasSetter\nattributes set to\ntrue\nvia getter/setter invo-\ncation.\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_90508] It shall advertise the Service Interface ID, Service Instance\nID, and\nServiceInterface\ncontract version via the\nara.com://services/-\ndiscovery\nDDS topic\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_90503]\n{DRAFT}\nAssigning a DDS DomainParticipant to a Service\nInstance\nd\nThe DDS Binding shall assign a DDS DomainParticipant to every Ser-\nvice Instance. The configuration of the DomainParticipant is described in the\nTPS_ManifestSpecification:\n167 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P168_330",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_90504",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 168,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\nThe Domain ID of the DomainParticipant shall be derived from the Manifest,\nwhere the\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\nelement defines the\ndomainId\n.\n\u000f\nThe QoS Profile of the DomainParticipant shall be derived from the Manifest,\nwhere the\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nqosProfile\n.\nBefore creating a new DomainParticipant, the DDS binding shall first look for existing\nDomainParticipants in the current process that match the configuration criteria speci-\nfied above\n8\n. If the search is successful, the binding shall assign the DomainParticipant\nfound to the Service\n9\n; otherwise, the binding shall create a new DomainParticipant\naccording to the desired configuration and assign it to the Service.\nOnce the DomainParticipant is available to the Service Instance, the binding implemen-\ntation shall create a DDS Publisher and a DDS Subscriber to enclose all DataWriters\nand DataReaders associated with the Service Instance.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00015, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\n[SWS_CM_90504]\n{DRAFT}\nAssigning a DDS Topic and a DDS DataWriter to ev-\nery Event in the ServiceInterface\nd\nThe DDS binding shall assign a DDS Topic to\nevery\nevent\nin the\nServiceInterface\naccording to the mapping rules specified\nin [SWS_CM_11015]. Since these DDS Topics may already be available in the Do-\nmainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance (e.g., because a different Service\nInstance assigned to the same DomainParticipant may have created them), the ser-\nvice shall first look for existing Topics in the DomainParticipant matching the required\ncriteria. If the search is unsuccessful, the DomainParticipant shall create a new DDS\nTopic to represent the\nevent\nas defined in [SWS_CM_11015].\nOnce all DDS Topics representing the\nevent\ns in the\nServiceInterface\nare ready\nfor use, the DomainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance shall create one DDS\nDataWriter of the equivalent Topic per\nevent\nusing the DDS Publisher created in\n[SWS_CM_90503]. The DataWriter shall be configured according to the\nqosProfile\nspecified in the associated\nDdsEventQosProps\n.\nTopic objects may be reused across service instances; therefore, they shall not be re-\nmoved until the enclosing DomainParticipant is destroyed.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_-\n00015)\n[SWS_CM_90505]\n{DRAFT}\nAssigning a DDS Request and Reply Topic, and\nDataWriters and DataReaders, to the Methods in the ServiceInterface\nd\nThe DDS\nbinding shall instantiate a DDS Service [22] to handle requests to all the\nmethod\ns in\nthe\nServiceInterface\n."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P169_331",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11100",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 169,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nIn practice, this implies assigning a DDS Request Topic and a DDS Reply Topic to the\nDDS Service that handles those method calls according to the mapping rules spec-\nified in [SWS_CM_11100]. Since these DDS Topics may already be available in the\nDomainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance (e.g., because a different Service\nInstance assigned to the same DomainParticipant may have created them), the service\nshall first look for existing Topics in the DomainParticipant matching the required crite-\nria. If the search is unsuccessful, the DomainParticipant shall create new DDS Request\nand Reply Topics to represent the DDS Service as specified in [SWS_CM_11100].\nOnce the corresponding DDS Request and Reply Topics are ready for use, the Do-\nmainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance shall create:\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11106] A DDS DataReader of the DDS Request Topic to handle re-\nquests using the DDS Subscriber created in [SWS_CM_90503].\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11107] A DDS DataWriter of the DDS Reply Topic to handle replies\nusing the DDS Publisher created in [SWS_CM_90503].\nTopic objects may be reused across service instances; therefore, they shall not be re-\nmoved until the enclosing DomainParticipant is destroyed.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_-\n00015, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\nThe handling of method calls with DDS is specified in 7.4.3.5.\n[SWS_CM_90506]\n{DRAFT}\nAssigning a DDS Topic and a DDS DataWriter to ev-\nery Field in the ServiceInterface with its hasNotifier attribute equal to true\nd\nThe\nDDS binding shall assign a DDS Topic to every\nfield\nin the\nServiceInterface\nwith its\nhasNotifier\nattribute set to\ntrue\naccording to the mapping rules specified\nin [SWS_CM_11130]. Since these DDS Topics may already be available in the Do-\nmainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance (e.g., because a different Service\nInstance assigned to the same DomainParticipant may have created them), the ser-\nvice shall first look for existing Topics in the DomainParticipant matching the required\ncriteria. If the search is unsuccessful, the DomainParticipant shall create a new DDS\nTopic to represent the\nfield\nas defined in [SWS_CM_11130].\nOnce all DDS Topics representing the\nfield\ns in the\nServiceInterface\nare ready\nfor use, the DomainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance shall create one DDS\nDataWriter of the equivalent Topic per\nfield\nwith the\nhasNotifier\nattribute set to\ntrue\nusing the DDS Publisher created in [SWS_CM_90503]. The DataWriter shall\nbe configured according to the\nqosProfile\nspecified in the associated\nDdsField-\nQosProps\n.\nTopic objects may be reused across service instances; therefore, they shall not be re-\nmoved until the enclosing DomainParticipant is destroyed.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_-\n00008, FO_RS_Dds_00015)\n169 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P170_332",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_90507",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 170,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_90507]\n{DRAFT}\nAssigning a DDS Request and Reply Topic, and\nDataWriters and DataReaders, to the Field Getters/Setters in the ServiceInter-\nface\nd\nThe DDS binding shall instantiate a DDS Service [22] to handle get/set requests\nto all the\nfield\ns in the\nServiceInterface\nwith\nhasGetter\nand/or\nhasSetter\nset\nto\ntrue\n.\nIn practice, this implies assigning a DDS Request Topic and a DDS Reply Topic to the\nDDS Service according to the mapping rules specified in [SWS_CM_11144]. Since\nthese DDS Topics may already be available in the DomainParticipant assigned to the\nService Instance (e.g., because a different Service Instance assigned to the same Do-\nmainParticipant may have created them), the service shall first look for existing Topics\nin the DomainParticipant matching the required criteria. If the search is unsuccessful,\nthe DomainParticipant shall create new DDS Request and Reply Topics to represent\nthe DDS Service as specified in [SWS_CM_11144].\nOnce the corresponding DDS Request and Reply Topics are ready for use, the Do-\nmainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance shall create:\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11149] A DDS DataReader of the DDS Request Topic to handle re-\nquests using the DDS Subscriber created in [SWS_CM_90503].\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_11150] A DDS DataWriter of the DDS Reply Topic to handle replies\nusing the DDS Publisher created in [SWS_CM_90503].\nTopic objects may be reused across service instances; therefore, they shall not be re-\nmoved until the enclosing DomainParticipant is destroyed.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00200, RS_CM_00101, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_-\n00015, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\nThe handling of fields with DDS is specified in section 7.4.3.6.\n[SWS_CM_90508]\n{DRAFT}\nAdvertising Service IDs, Service Instance IDs, and\nServiceInterface Contract Versions over the\nara.com://services/discovery\ntopic\nd\nThe binding implementation shall configure DDS Topic, Publisher and\nDataWriter objects supporting the publication of announcement messages over\nthe\nara.com://services/discovery\ntopic, whose type is\nServiceAnnounce-\nmentMessage\nand is defined as follows\n10\n:"
    },

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "25\n}; // module dds\nWhere:\ninterface_id\nis the Service Instance ID derived from the Manifest, where\nthe\nDdsServiceInterfaceDeployment\ndefines the\nserviceInterfaceId\n.\nThe value of this field contributes to the topic instance key\ninstance_id\nis the Service Instance ID derived from the Manifest, where\nthe\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nserviceInter-\nfaceId\n. The value of this field contributes to the topic instance key\nversion\nis derived from the Manifest, where the\nmajorVersion\nelement of the\nServiceInterface\ndefines the contract major version, and the\nminorVer-\nsion\nelement of the\nServiceInterface\ndefines the contract minor version\nidentifier_type\ndefines the protocol used by consumers of the Service Instance\nto bind themselves with it. This choice will determine topic naming, usage\nof partitions and the relevance of in-band instance identifers in the follow-\ning requirements: [SWS_CM_11015], [SWS_CM_11100], [SWS_CM_11130],\n[SWS_CM_11144] and [SWS_CM_10524].\nIn order to guarantee reception of\nServiceAnnouncementMessage\nsamples by all\nService Interface consumers, including those joining after the Service Instance has\nbeen advertised, the following DataWriter QoS policies shall be set for the\nara.com:-\n//services/discovery\ntopic:\n\u000f\nRELIABILITY\nset to\nRELIABLE\n\u000f\nHISTORY\nset to\nKEEP_LAST\nwith\nDEPTH\nset to 1\n\u000f\nDURABILITY\nset to\nTRANSIENT_LOCAL\nOnce the\nara.com://services/discovery\ntopic DataWriter is properly set up and\nready to use, the offering Service Instance shall:\n1. Instantiate a\nServiceAnnouncementMessage\nsample, update it with the\nproper values uniquely identifying the Service Instance, and use it to register\n171 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

Use the Instance Handle returned by the previous step to publish the sample via\nwrite()\n3. Keep a copy the sample and the Instance Handle for use upon Service Instance\ntear down (see [SWS_CM_11005])\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00101, RS_CM_00500, RS_CM_00501,\nFO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00007, FO_RS_Dds_00008,\nFO_RS_Dds_00015)\n[SWS_CM_90509]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of StopOfferService method\nd\nWhen instructed\nto stop offering a Service, the DDS Binding shall perform the following operations:\n\u000f\nCall\ndispose()\nusing the sample and the Instance Handle kept during Service\nInstance announcement (see [SWS_CM_90508])\n\u000f\nIt shall remove all DDS DataWriters associated with\nevent\ns in the\nServiceIn-\nterface\ncreated in previous calls to the\nOfferService()\nmethod.\n\u000f\nIt shall remove all DDS DataWriters and DataReaders associated with the\nClientServerOperation\ns defined in the role\nmethod\ncreated in previous\ncalls to the\nOfferService()\nmethod.\n\u000f\nIt shall remove all DDS DataWriters associated with\nfield\ns in the\nServiceIn-\nterface\nwith their\nhasNotifier\nattribute set to\ntrue\ncreated in previous calls\nto the\nOfferService()\nmethod.\n\u000f\nIt shall remove all DDS DataWriters and DataReaders associated with the\nfield\ns in the\nServiceInterface\nwith\nhasGetter\nand/or\nhasSetter\nat-\ntributes set to\ntrue\ncreated in previous calls to the\nOfferService()\nmethod.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00105, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_90510]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of FindService method\nd\nWhen instructed to\nfind remote Services, the DDS Binding shall perform the following operations:\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_90511] It shall look for an existing DDS DomainParticipant capable of\nfinding remote Services Instances. If such DomainParticipant does not exist, the\nDDS binding shall create a new one as specified in [SWS_CM_90512].\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_90513] It shall create a DataReader matching the Topic and QoS\npolicies defined by [SWS_CM_90508], looking into all samples received for those\nassociated with Service Instances that: (1) match the filter criteria specified in\nthe\nFindService()\ncall, (2) have a compatible\nServiceInterface\ncontract\nversion, and (3) have a\nServiceInterface\ncontract version that is not part of\na\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\n.\nblocklistedVersion\n.\n\u000f\nIt shall return a\nHandleType\nobject for every Service Instance that: (1) matches\nthe filter criteria, (2) has a compatible\nServiceInterface\ncontract version, and\n172 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
