      "source_page": 173,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n(3) has a\nServiceInterface\ncontract version that is not part of a\nDdsRe-\nquiredServiceInstance\n.\nblocklistedVersion\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_90511]\n{DRAFT}\nFinding a DDS DomainParticipant suitable for per-\nforming client-side operations\nd\nThe DDS binding shall provide client-side methods\nwith a DDS DomainParticipant capable of discovering and communicating with remote\nDDS DomainParticipants assigned to the requested Service Instance(s). The configu-\nration of the DomainParticipant is described in the TPS_ManifestSpecification:\n\u000f\nThe Domain ID of the DomainParticipant shall be derived from the Manifest,\nwhere the\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\nelement defines the\ndomainId\n.\n\u000f\nThe QoS Profile of the DomainParticipant shall be derived from the Manifest,\nwhere the\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nqosProfile\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_90512]\n{DRAFT}\nCreating a DDS DomainParticipant suitable for per-\nforming client-side operations\nd\nTo create a DomainParticipant capable of discov-\nering and communicating with remote DDS DomainParticipants assigned to Service\nInstances, the binding implementation shall use the configuration parameters in the\nTPS_ManifestSpecification described in [SWS_CM_90511].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_-\nCM_00200, RS_CM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_90513]\n{DRAFT}\nDiscovering remote Service Instances through the\nara.com://services/discovery topic\nd\nDDS DomainParticipants created or retrieved\nin the context of Service Discoverty are responsible for discovering remote Domain-\nParticipants assigned to ara::com Service Instances.\nTo retrieve a list of discovered Service Instances, the DDS binding shall pro-\ncess inbound\nServiceAnnouncementMessage\nsamples from the\nara.com:/-\n/services/discovery\ntopic. This shall be done by calling\nread()\non the\nDataReader object defined by [SWS_CM_90510].\nIf\nrequiredServiceInstanceId\nis set to\nALL\n, the binding shall return a new handle\nfor each service instance declared by inbound\nServiceAnnouncementMessage\n, as\nlong as its\ninterface_id\nfield matches the corresponding\nserviceInterfaceId\n.\nElse, if\nrequiredServiceInstanceId\nis set to any value other than\nALL\n, the\nbinding should return a new handle for each service instance declared by inbound\nServiceAnnouncementMessage\n, as long as its\ninterface_id\nfield matches the\nserviceInterfaceId\nand its\ninstance_id\nfield matches\nrequiredServiceIn-\nstanceId\n.\nIn either case, before returning new handles, the binding implementation shall evalu-\nate the\nServiceInterface\ncontract version for the corresponding Service Instance\n173 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 174,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nin the content of the\nServiceAnnouncementMessage\nsamples. The binding shall\nreturn a new handle only if:\n1. The\nServiceInterface\ncontract version of the discovered service instance is\ncompatible with the\nserviceInterfaceDeployment\nversion of the\nDdsRe-\nquiredServiceInstance\naccording to [RS_CM_00501]\n2. The\nServiceInterface\ncontract version is not part of any\nDdsRequiredSer-\nviceInstance\n.\nblocklistedVersion\n, according to [RS_CM_00701].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_90514]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of StartFindService method\nd\nWhen instructed\nto start a continuous service search, the DDS Binding shall perform the following op-\nerations:\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_90511] It shall look for an existing DDS DomainParticipant capable of\nfinding remote Service Instances. If such DomainParticipant does not exist, the\nDDS binding shall create it as specified in [SWS_CM_90512].\n\u000f\nIt shall continuously monitor arrival of\nServiceAnnouncementMessage\nsam-\nples through the\nara.com://services/discovery\ntopic, calling\nFindSer-\nviceHandler\nwhenever a matching Service Instance is discovered.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00102, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_90515]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of StopFindService method\nd\nWhen instructed\nto stop a continuous service search initiated by a previous call to\nStartFindService\n()\n, the DDS Binding shall perform the following operations:\n\u000f\n[SWS_CM_90511] It shall look for an existing DDS DomainParticipant capable\nof finding remote Service Instances. If such DomainParticipant does not exist,\nStopFindService()\nshall return and perform no further action.\n\u000f\nIt shall stop monitoring the arrival of\nServiceAnnouncementMessage\nsamples\nthrough the\nara.com://services/discovery\ntopic.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n7.4.3.3 Handling Events\n[SWS_CM_11015] Mapping Events to DDS Topics\nd\nThe DDS binding shall map ev-\nery\nVariableDataPrototype\ndefined in the\nServiceInterface\nin the role\nevent\nto a DDS Topic. The equivalent DDS Topic shall be configured as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Topic Name shall be derived from the Manifest according to the following\nrules:\n174 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "source_page": 175,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\nIf the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSERVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\nor\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_INSTANCE_ID\n, then the topic name shall\nbe set to\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<Major>.<Minor>\n/<TopicName>\n\nAdditionally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has\nbeen advertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, then samples of this topic shall\nbe sent and received via DataWriters and DataReaders whose respective\nparent Publisher and Subscriber objects include the following partition in the\nPARTITION QoS policy:\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<In-\nstanceId>\n\nFinally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_TOPIC_PREFIX\n, then the topic name shall be set\nto\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<InstanceID>/<Topic-\nName>\n\nWhere:\n<InterfaceID>\nis the value of\nDdsServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nserviceInterfaceId\n<InstanceID>\nis the value of either\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\n.\nserviceInstanceId\nor\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\n.\nre-\nquiredServiceInstanceId\n<Major>\nand\n<Minor>\nare the values of\nServiceInterface\n.\nma-\njorVersion\nand\nServiceInterface\n.\nminorVersion\n, respectively\n<TopicName>\nis the value of\nDdsEventDeployment\n.\ntopicName\n\u000f\nThe Topic Data Type shall be defined as specified in [SWS_CM_11016], and shall\nbe registered under the equivalent data type name.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00007, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11016] DDS Topic data type definition\nd\nThe data type of a DDS Topic\nrepresenting an Event shall be constructed according to the following IDL definition:\n1\nstruct <eventTypeName>EventType {\n2\n@key uint16 instance_id;\n3\n<eventTypeName> data;\n4\n};\nWhere:\n<eventTypeName>\nis the\nCpp Implementation Data Type symbol\n175 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P176_339",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11017",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 176,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\ninstance_id\nis a\n@key\nmember of the type, which identifies all samples with the\nsame\ninstance_id\nas samples of the same Topic Instance.\ndata\nis the actual value of the\nevent\n, which shall be constructed and encoded ac-\ncording to the DDS serialization rules. The\n@external\nannotation is optionally\nallowed, for cases where references yield implementation benefits over values.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00007)\nThe DDS serialization rules are defined in section 7.4.3.7.\n[SWS_CM_11017] Mapping of Send method\nd\nWhen instructed to send an event\nmessage, the DDS Binding shall construct a new sample of the equivalent DDS Topic\ndata type (see [SWS_CM_11016]) as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Instance Id field (\ninstance_id\n) shall be derived from the Manifest, where\nthe\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nserviceInstan-\nceId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Data field (\ndata\n) shall point to the\ndata\ninput parameter of the\nSend()\nmethod.\nThat sample shall be then passed as a parameter to the\nwrite()\nmethod of the DDS\nDataWriter associated with the\nevent\n, which shall serialize the sample according\nto the serialization rules, and publish it over DDS.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201,\nFO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00015)\nThe DDS serialization rules are defined in section 7.4.3.7.\n[SWS_CM_11018] Mapping of Subscribe method\nd\nWhen instructed to subscribe to\nan event, the DDS binding shall create a DDS DataReader using the DDS Subscriber\ncreated for the proxy in [SWS_CM_11009]. The rules to create the DataReader are\nspecified in [SWS_CM_11019].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00103, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\n[SWS_CM_11019] Creating a DDS DataReader for event subscription\nd\nThe\nDDS binding shall create a DDS DataReader for the Topic associated with\nthe\nevent\n(see [SWS_CM_11015]). If the provided or consumed Service In-\nstance has been advertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, to ensure the proxy communicates only\nwith the service instance it is bound to, the binding implementation shall use the DDS\nSubscriber created in [SWS_CM_11002] (whose partition name is\n\"ara.com://-\nservices/<svcId>_<reqSvcInId>\"\n) to create the DataReader.\nThe DataReader shall be configured as follows:\n\u000f\nDataReaderQos\nshall be set as specified in the Manifest, where the\nDdsEven-\ntQosProps\nelement defines the\nqosProfile\nthat shall be used. To configure\nthe DataReader's cache size according to the\nmaxSampleCount\nspecified in the\nSubscribe()\nmethod call, the value of the DataReader's HISTORY QoS speci-\nfied in\nqosProfile\nshall be overridden as follows:\n176 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P177_340",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11020",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 177,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\nhistory.kind = KEEP_LAST_HISTORY_QOS\n\nhistory.depth = <maxSampleCount>\n\u000f\nListener\nshall be an instance of the\nDataReaderListener\nclass specified in\n[SWS_CM_11020].\n\u000f\nStatusMask\nshall be set to\nSTATUS_MASK_NONE\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00103, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00016, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11020] Defining a DDS DataReaderListener\nd\nThe DDS Binding imple-\nmentation shall define a\nDataReaderListener\nclass capable of handling notifica-\ntions when a new sample is received and/or when the matched status of the subscrip-\ntion changes. This class shall derive from the standard\nDataReaderListener\nclass\n[19], specifying that the samples to be handled are of the Topic data type specified in\n[SWS_CM_11016].\nThe\nDataReaderListener\nshall implement the following methods according to the\nspecified instructions:\n\u000f\nA Constructor that initializes two member variables that hold references to an\nEventReceiveHandler\nand a\nSubscriptionStateChangeHandler\n.\n\u000f\nAn\non_data_available()\nmethod that calls the\nEventReceiveHandler\nif it\nhas been set and there are valid samples in the DataReader's cache.\n\u000f\nAn\non_subscription_matched()\nmethod that calls\nGetSubscription-\nState()\nand passes the resulting\nSubscriptionState\nto\nSubscription-\nStateChangeHandler\nif it has been set.\n\u000f\nA\nset_event_receive_handler()\nmethod that takes as an input parameter\na reference to an\nEventReceiveHandler\nand updates the member variable\nholding a reference to an\nEventReceiveHandler\nto point to the input parame-\nter.\n\u000f\nA\nset_subscription_state_change_handler()\nmethod that takes as an\ninput parameter a reference to a\nSubscriptionStateChangeHandler\nand\nupdates the member variable holding a reference to a\nSubscriptionState-\nChangeHandler\nto point to the input parameter.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00103, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00016)\n[SWS_CM_11021] Mapping of Unsubscribe method\nd\nWhen instructed to unsub-\nscribe from a service event, the DDS binding shall delete the DataReader associ-\nated with the\nevent\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00104, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00008)\n177 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P178_341",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11022",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 178,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_11022] Mapping of GetSubscriptionState method\nd\nWhen instructed to\nprovide the subscription state, the DDS binding shall check if the DataReader associ-\nated with the subscription exists:\n\u000f\nIf it does exist, the binding shall call the DataReader's\nget_subscription_matched_status()\nmethod next.\n\nIf the\ntotal_count\nattribute of the resulting\nSubscriptionMatched-\nStatus\nis greater than zero,\nGetSubscriptionState()\nshall return\nSubscriptionState = kSubscribed\n.\n\nOtherwise, it shall return\nSubscriptionState = kSubscription-\nPending\n.\n\u000f\nElse, if it does not existwhich indicates that either\nSubscribe()\nhas never in-\nvoked or\nUnsubscribe()\nhas been called before\nGetSubscriptionState\n()\nshall return\nSubscriptionState = kNotSubscribed\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00106, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11023] Mapping of GetNewSamples method\nd\nWhen instructed to get\nnew samples, the DDS binding shall perform a\ntake()\non the DataReader as follows:\n\u000f\nIf a\nmaxNumberOfSamples\nis specified, the binding implementation shall invoke\ntake()\nwith\nmax_samples = maxNumberOfSamples\n.\n\u000f\nElse, if no\nmaxNumberOfSamples\nis specified (i.e., if\nmaxNumberOfSam-\nples\nis equal to the default value\nstd::numeric_limits<std::size_t>\n::max()\n), the binding implementation shall invoke\ntake()\nwithout specifying\na\nmax_samples\nlimit.\nAfter calling\ntake()\n, the binding implementation shall invoke the\nCallable f\nfor\nevery valid sample taken from the DataReader's cache (i.e., every sample with\nSampleInfo.valid_data\nequal to\ntrue\n), providing\nf\nwith a reference to the corre-\nsponding sample.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00202, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11024] Mapping of GetFreeSampleCount method\nd\nWhen instructed to\nprovide the number of free sample slots, the binding implementation shall return the\nnumber free sample slots in the DDS DataReader's cache.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00202, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11025] Mapping of SetReceiveHandler method\nd\nWhen instructed to reg-\nister an\nEventReceiveHandler\n, the binding implementation shall perform the follow-\ning operations:\n\u000f\nIt shall get a reference to the DataReader's listener using the\nget_listener()\nmethod.\n178 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

      "source_page": 179,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\nIt shall use the\nset_event_receive_handler()\nmethod to instruct the lis-\ntener to invoke the new\nEventReceiveHandler\nwhenever there is data avail-\nable.\n\u000f\nIt shall update the DataReader's listener by calling\nset_listener()\nwith\nlis-\ntener\nequal to the new listener object and\nStatusMask\nset as follows:\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nSTATUS_MASK_NONE\nor\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n, set it to\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n.\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nSUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n, set it to\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS|SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n.\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS|SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n, set\nit to\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS|SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00203, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11026] Mapping of UnsetReceiveHandler method\nd\nWhen instructed to\nunregister an\nEventReceiveHandler\n, the binding implementation shall perform the\nfollowing operations:\n\u000f\nIt shall get a reference to the DataReader's listener using the\nget_listener()\nmethod.\n\u000f\nIt shall use the\nset_event_receive_handler()\nmethod to unset the internal\nEventReceiveHandler\nthat is called whenever there is data available.\n\u000f\nIt shall update the DataReader's listener by calling\nset_listener()\nwith\nlis-\ntener\nequal to the new listener object and\nStatusMask\nset as follows:\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nSTATUS_MASK_NONE\nor\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n, set it to\nSTATUS_MASK_NONE\n.\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nSUBSCRIP-\nTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n, set it to\nSUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n.\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS|SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n, set\nit to\nSUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00203, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11027] Mapping of SetSubscriptionStateHandler method\nd\nWhen in-\nstructed to register a\nSubscriptionStateChangeHandler\n, the binding implemen-\ntation shall perform the following operations:\n\u000f\nIt shall get a reference to the DataReader's listener using the\nget_listener()\nmethod.\n179 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

it\nto\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS|SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n.\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS|SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n, set\nit to\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS|SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00106, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11028] Mapping of UnsetSubscriptionStateHandler method\nd\nWhen in-\nstructed to unregister a\nSubscriptionStateChangeHandler\n, the binding imple-\nmentation shall perform the following operations:\n\u000f\nIt shall get a reference to the DataReader's listener called whenever there is a change in the\nSubscriptionMatchedSta-\ntus\n.\n\u000f\nIt shall update the DataReader's listener by calling\nset_listener()\nwith\nlis-\ntener\nequal to the new listener object and\nStatusMask\nset as follows:\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nSTATUS_MASK_NONE\nor\nSUB-\nSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n, set it to\nSTATUS_MASK_NONE\n.\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n, set it\nto\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n.\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS|SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n, set\nit to\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00106, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n180 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "source_page": 181,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n7.4.3.4 Handling Triggers\n[SWS_CM_10524]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping Triggers to DDS Topics\nd\nThe DDS binding\nshall map every\nTrigger\ndefined in the\nServiceInterface\nin the role\ntrigger\nto a DDS Topic. The equivalent DDS Topic shall be configured as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Topic Name shall be derived from the Manifest according to the following\nrules:\n\nIf the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSERVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\nor\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_INSTANCE_ID\n, then the topic name shall\nbe set to\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<Major>.<Minor>\n/<TopicName>\n\nAdditionally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has\nbeen advertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, then samples of this topic shall\nbe sent and received via DataWriters and DataReaders whose respective\nparent Publisher and Subscriber objects include the following partition in the\nPARTITION QoS policy:\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<In-\nstanceId>\n\nFinally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_TOPIC_PREFIX\n, then the topic name shall be set\nto\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<InstanceID>/<Topic-\nName>\n\nWhere:\n<InterfaceID>\nis the value of\nDdsServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nserviceInterfaceId\n<InstanceID>\nis the value of either\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\n.\nserviceInstanceId\nor\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\n.\nre-\nquiredServiceInstanceId\n<Major>\nand\n<Minor>\nare the values of\nServiceInterface\n.\nma-\njorVersion\nand\nServiceInterface\n.\nminorVersion\n, respectively\n<TopicName>\nis the value of\nDdsEventDeployment\n.\ntopicName\nassoci-\nated with the\ntrigger\n\u000f\nThe Topic Data Type shall be defined as specified in [SWS_CM_10525], and shall\nbe registered under the equivalent data type name.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00007, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n181 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P182_345",

      "source_page": 182,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_10525]\n{DRAFT}\nDDS Topic data type definition\nd\nThe data type of a DDS\nTopic representing a trigger shall be constructed according to the following IDL defini-\ntion:\n1\nstruct TriggerType {\n2\n@key uint16 instanceIdentifier;\n3\n};\nWhere:\ninstance_id\nis a\n@key\nmember of the type, which identifies all samples with the\nsame\ninstance_id\nas samples of the same Topic Instance.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00007)\n[SWS_CM_10526]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of Send method\nd\nWhen instructed to send a\ntrigger message, the DDS Binding shall construct a new sample of the equivalent DDS\nTopic data type (see [SWS_CM_10525]) as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Instance Id field (\ninstance_id\n) shall be derived from the Manifest, where\nthe\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nserviceInstan-\nceId\n.\nThat sample shall be then passed as a parameter to the\nwrite()\nmethod of the DDS\nDataWriter associated with the\ntrigger\n, which shall serialize the sample according\nto the serialization rules, and publish it over DDS.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201,\nFO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00015)\nThe DDS serialization rules are defined in section 7.4.3.7.\n[SWS_CM_10527]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of Subscribe method\nd\nWhen instructed to sub-\nscribe to a trigger, the DDS binding shall create a DDS DataReader using the DDS\nSubscriber created for the proxy in [SWS_CM_11009] or [SWS_CM_90513]. The rules\nto create the DataReader are specified in [SWS_CM_10528].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_-\nCM_00103, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\n[SWS_CM_10528]\n{DRAFT}\nCreating a DDS DataReader for trigger subscrip-\ntion\nd\nThe DDS binding shall create a DDS DataReader for the Topic associated\nwith the\ntrigger\n(see [SWS_CM_10524]). If the provided or consumed Service\nInstance has been advertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, to ensure the proxy communicates only\nwith the service instance it is bound to, the binding implementation shall use the DDS\nSubscriber created in [SWS_CM_11009] (whose partition name is\n\"ara.com://-\nservices/<svcId>_<reqSvcInId>\"\n) to create the DataReader.\nThe DataReader shall be configured as follows:\n\u000f\nDataReaderQos\nshall be set as specified in the Manifest, where the\nDdsEven-\ntQosProps\nelement defines the\nqosProfile\nthat shall be used.\n\u000f\nListener\nshall be an instance of the\nDataReaderListener\nclass specified in\n[SWS_CM_11020].\n182 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\nStatusMask\nshall be set to\nSTATUS_MASK_NONE\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00103, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\n[SWS_CM_10529]\n{DRAFT}\nDefining a DDS DataReaderListener\nd\nThe DDS Bind-\ning implementation shall define a\nDataReaderListener\nclass capable of handling\nnotifications when a new sample is received and/or when the matched status of the\nsubscription changes. This class shall derive from the standard\nDataReaderLis-\ntener\nclass [19], specifying that the samples to be handled are of the Topic data type\nspecified in [SWS_CM_10525].\nThe\nDataReaderListener\nshall implement the following methods according to the\nspecified instructions:\n\u000f\nA Constructor that initializes two member variables that hold references to an\nTriggerReceiveHandler\nand a\nSubscriptionStateChangeHandler\n.\n\u000f\nAn\non_data_available()\nmethod that calls the\nTriggerReceiveHandler\nif it has been set and there are valid samples in the DataReader's cache.\n\u000f\nAn\non_subscription_matched()\nmethod that calls\nGetSubscription-\nState()\nand passes the resulting\nSubscriptionState\nto\nSubscription-\nStateChangeHandler\nif it has been set.\n\u000f\nA\nset_trigger_receive_handler()\nmethod that takes as an input parame-\nter a reference to an\nTriggerReceiveHandler\nand updates the member vari-\nable holding a reference to an\nTriggerReceiveHandler\nto point to the input\nparameter.\n\u000f\nA\nset_subscription_state_change_handler()\nmethod that takes as an\ninput parameter a reference to a\nSubscriptionStateChangeHandler\nand\nupdates the member variable holding a reference to a\nSubscriptionState-\nChangeHandler\nto point to the input parameter.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00103, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00016)\n[SWS_CM_10530]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of Unsubscribe method\nd\nWhen instructed to\nunsubscribe from a service trigger, the DDS binding shall delete the DataReader as-\nsociated with the\ntrigger\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00104, FO_RS_Dds_00001,\nFO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_10531]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of GetSubscriptionState method\nd\nWhen\ninstructed to provide the subscription state, the DDS binding shall check if the\nDataReader associated with the subscription exists:\n\u000f\nIf it does exist, the binding shall call the DataReader's\nget_subscription_matched_status()\nmethod next.\n183 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\nIf the\ntotal_count\nattribute of the resulting\nSubscriptionMatched-\nStatus\nis greater than indicates that either\nSubscribe()\nhas never in-\nvoked or\nUnsubscribe()\nhas been called before\nGetSubscriptionState\n()\nshall return\nSubscriptionState = kNotSubscribed\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00106, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_10532]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of GetNewTriggers method\nd\nWhen instructed\nto get new triggers, the DDS binding shall perform a\ntake()\non the DataReader with-\nout specifying a\nmax_samples\nlimit.\nAfter calling\ntake()\n, the binding implementation shall increase the internal trigger\ncount proportionally to the number of samples returned an\nTriggerReceiveHandler\n, the binding implementation shall\nperform the following operations:\n\u000f\nIt shall get a reference to the DataReader's listener using the\nget_listener()\nmethod.\n\u000f\nIt shall use the\nset_trigger_receive_handler()\nmethod to instruct the lis-\ntener to invoke the new\nTriggerReceiveHandler\nwhenever there is data avail-\nable.\n\u000f\nIt shall update the DataReader's listener by calling\nset_listener()\nwith\nlis-\ntener\nequal to the new listener object and\nStatusMask\nset as follows:\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nSTATUS_MASK_NONE\nor\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n, set it to\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n.\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nSUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n, set it to\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS|SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n.\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS|SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n, set\nit to\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS|SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00203, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_10535]\n{DRAFT}\nMapping of UnsetReceiveHandler method\nd\nWhen in-\nstructed to unregister an\nTriggerReceiveHandler\n, the binding implementation\nshall perform the following operations:\n184 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\nIt shall get a reference to the DataReader's listener using the\nget_listener()\nmethod.\n\u000f\nIt shall use the\nset_subscription_state_change_handler()\nmethod to\ninstruct the listener to unset the internal\nSubscriptionStateChangeHandler\nthat is called whenever there is a change in the\nSubscriptionMatchedSta-\ntus\n.\n\u000f\nIt shall update the DataReader's listener by calling\nset_listener()\nwith\nlis-\ntener\nequal to the new listener object and\nStatusMask\nset as follows:\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nSTATUS_MASK_NONE\nor\nSUB-\nSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n, set it to\nSTATUS_MASK_NONE\n.\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n, set it\nto\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n.\n\nIf the original value of\nStatusMask\nwas\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS|SUBSCRIPTION_MATCHED_STATUS\n, set\nit to\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00106, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00016)\n7.4.3.5 Handling Method Calls\nThe RPC over DDS Specification (DDS-RPC) [22] introduces the concept of DDS Ser-\nvices. These Services provide the mechanisms required to define and implement\nmethods that can be invoked remotely by DDS client applications using the build-\ning blocks of the DDS data-centric publish-subscribe middleware [19]. In this section,\nwe specify how to handle ara::com method calls over DDS by defining the appropriate\nmapping between ara::com service methods and DDS service methods.\n[SWS_CM_11100] Mapping Methods to DDS Service Methods and Topics\nd\nEvery\nServiceInterface\ncontaining one or more\nClientServerOperation\ns defined in\nthe role\nmethod\nshall have an associated DDS Service to enable ara::com Service\nInstances to offer those operations, and to enable client applications to invoke them.\nThe equivalent DDS Service shall provide all of the\nmethod\ns of the corresponding\nServiceInterface\n.\nDDS Services shall be constructed according to the Basic Service Mapping Profile of\nthe RPC over DDS specification [22], which assigns two DDS Topics to every DDS Ser-\nvice: a Request Topic and a Reply Topic. Thus, every\nServiceInterface\ncontaining\none or more\nClientServerOperation\ns defined in the role\nmethod\nshall trigger the\ncreation of two equivalent DDS Topics.\nThe equivalent DDS Request Topic shall be configured as follows:\n186 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P187_350",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11101",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 187,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\nThe Request Topic Name shall be derived from the Manifest according to the\nfollowing rules:\n\nIf the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSERVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\nor\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_INSTANCE_ID\n, then the topic name shall\nbe set to\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<Major>.<Minor>\n/<TopicName>\n\nAdditionally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has\nbeen advertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, then samples of this topic shall\nbe sent and received via DataWriters and DataReaders whose respective\nparent Publisher and Subscriber objects include the following partition in the\nPARTITION QoS policy:\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<In-\nstanceId>\n\nFinally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_TOPIC_PREFIX\n, then the topic name shall be set\nto\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<InstanceID>/<Topic-\nName>\n<InterfaceID>\nis the value of\nDdsServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nserviceInterfaceId\n<InstanceID>\nis the value of either\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\n.\nserviceInstanceId\nor\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\n.\nre-\nquiredServiceInstanceId\n<Major> and <Minor>\nare the values of\nServiceInterface\n.\nma-\njorVersion\nand\nServiceInterface\n.\nminorVersion\n, respectively\n<TopicName>\nis the value of\nDdsServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nmethodRequestTopicName\n\u000f\nThe Request Topic Data Type shall be defined as specified in [SWS_CM_11101],\nand shall be registered under the equivalent data type's name.\nThe equivalent DDS Reply Topic shall be configured as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Reply Topic Name shall be derived from the Manifest according to the fol-\nlowing rules:\n\nIf the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSERVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\nor\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_INSTANCE_ID\n, then the topic name shall\nbe set to\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<Major>.<Minor>\n/<TopicName>\n187 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P188_351",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11102",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 188,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\nAdditionally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has\nbeen advertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, then samples of this topic shall\nbe sent and received via DataWriters and DataReaders whose respective\nparent Publisher and Subscriber objects include the following partition in the\nPARTITION QoS policy:\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<In-\nstanceId>\n\nFinally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_TOPIC_PREFIX\n, then the topic name shall be set\nto\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<InstanceID>/<Topic-\nName>\n\nWhere:\n<InterfaceID>\nis the value of\nDdsServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nserviceInterfaceId\n<InstanceID>\nis the value of either\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\n.\nserviceInstanceId\nor\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\n.\nre-\nquiredServiceInstanceId\n<Major> and <Minor>\nare the values of\nServiceInterface\n.\nma-\njorVersion\nand\nServiceInterface\n.\nminorVersion\n, respectively\n<TopicName>\nis the value of\nDdsServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nmethodReplyTopicName\n\u000f\nThe Reply Topic Data Type shall be defined as specified in [SWS_CM_11102],\nand shall be registered under the equivalent data type's name.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11101] DDS Service Request Topic data type definition\nd\nAs specified\nin section 7.5.1.1.6 of [22], the Request Topic data type is a structure composed of a\nRequest Header with meta-data a Call Structure with data. The IDL definition of the\nRequest Topic data type is the following:\n1\nstruct <svcId>Method_Request {\n2\ndds::rpc::RequestHeader header;\n3\n<svcId>Method_Call data;\n4\n};\nWhere:\n<svcId>\nis the corresponding\nserviceInterfaceId\n.\ndds::rpc::RequestHeader\nis the standard Request Header defined in section\n7.5.1.1.1 of [22].\n188 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P189_352",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 189,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n<svcId>Method_Call\nis the union that holds the value of the input parameters of\nthe corresponding methods, according to the rules specified in section 7.5.1.1.6\nof [22].\ndds::rpc::RequestHeader\nshall be constructed as specified in section 7.5.1.1.1\nof [22]. On top of that, the binding implementation shall set\ninstanceName\n(a mem-\nber of the\nRequestHeader\nstructure that specifies the DDS Service instance name)\nto a string representation of the\nserviceInstanceId\nof the service instance that\nprovides the methods.\n<svcId>Method_Call\nshall be constructed as specified in section 7.5.1.1.6 of [22]:\n\u000f\nThe name of the union shall be\n<svcId>Method_Call\n.\n\u000f\nThe union discriminator shall be a 32-bit signed integer.\n\u000f\nThe union shall have a default case of type\ndds::rpc::UnknownOperation\n(defined in section 7.5.1.1.1 of [22]) for unsupported and unknown operations.\n\u000f\nThe union shall have a case label for each\nClientServerOperation\ndefined\nin the\nServiceInterface\nwith the role\nmethod\n, where:\n\nThe integer value of the case label shall be a 32-bit hash of the\nClientServerOperation\n's\nshortName\n. The binding implementation\nshall compute the hash as specified in section 7.5.1.1.2 of [22]. Represen-\ntations of the service interface in OMG IDL [24] shall define 32-bit signed\ninteger constants (i.e.,\nconst int32 <svcId>Method_<methodName>\n_Hash\n; where\n<methodName>\nis the\nshortName\nof the\nClientServer-\nOperation\n) to simplify the representation of the union cases (see below).\n\nThe member name for the case label shall be the\nshortName\nof the\nClientServerOperation\n.\n\nThe type for each case label shall be\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>\n_In\n, which shall be constructed as specified in section 7.5.1.1.4 of [22] (see\nbelow).\nThe IDL definition of the\n<svcId>Method_Call\nunion is the following:\n1\nunion <svcId>Method_Call switch(int32) {\n2\ndefault:\n3\ndds::rpc::UnknownOperation unknownOp;\n4\ncase <svcId>Method_<method0Name>_Hash:\n5\n<svcId>Method_<method0Name>_In <method0Name>;\n6\ncase <svcId>Method_<method1Name>_Hash:\n7\n<svcId>Method_<method1Name>_In <method1Name>;\n8\n// ...\n9\ncase <svcId>Method_<methodNName>_Hash:\n10\n<svcId>Method_<methodNName>_In <methodNName>;\n11\n};\nAs defined in section 7.5.1.1.4 of [22], the\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>_In\nstructure shall contain as members all the\nArgumentDataPrototype\ns of the\n189 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P190_353",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11102",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 190,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nClientServerOperation\nwith\ndirection\nset to\nin\nor\ninout\n. The IDL repre-\nsentation of\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>_In\nis the following:\n1\nstruct <svcId>Method_<methodName>_In {\n2\n<ArgumentDataPrototype[0]>;\n3\n<ArgumentDataPrototype[1]>;\n4\n// ...\n5\n<ArgumentDataPrototype[n]>;\n6\n};\nIn accordance with [22], for methods with no input parameters, the DDS binding shall\ngenerate a\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>_In\nstructure with a single member\nnamed\ndummy\nof type\ndds::rpc::UnusedMember\n(see section 7.5.1.1.1 of [22]).\nThe resulting Request Topic data type shall be encoded according to the DDS serial-\nization rules. Unions, such as the\n<svcId>Method_Call\nunion, shall be serialized as\nspecified in section 7.4.3.5 of [21].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213,\nRS_CM_00200, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00007)\n[SWS_CM_11102] DDS Service Reply Topic data type definition\nd\nAs specified in\nsection 7.5.1.1.7 of [22], the Reply Topic data type is a structure composed of a Reply\nHeader with meta-data and a Return Structure with data. The IDL definition of the\nReply Topic data type is the following:\n1\nstruct <svcId>Method_Reply {\n2\ndds::rpc::ReplyHeader header;\n3\n<svcId>Method_Return data;\n4\n};\nWhere:\n<svcId>\nis the corresponding\nserviceInterfaceId\n.\ndds::rpc::ReplyHeader\nis the standard Reply Header defined in section 7.5.1.1.1\nof [22].\n<svcId>Method_Return\nis the union that holds the return values (i.e., return values,\noutput parameter values, and/or errors) of the corresponding response, according\nto the rules specified in section 7.5.1.1.7 of [22].\ndds::rpc::ReplyHeader\nshall be constructed as specified in section 7.5.1.1.1 of\n[22].\n<svcId>Method_Return\nshall be constructed as specified in section 7.5.1.1.7 of\n[22]:\n\u000f\nThe name of the union shall be\n<svcId>Method_Return\n.\n\u000f\nThe union discriminator shall be a 32-bit signed integer.\n\u000f\nThe union shall have a default case of type\ndds::rpc::UnknownOperation\n(defined in section 7.5.1.1.1 of [22]) for unsupported and unknown operations.\n190 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\u000f\nThe union shall have a case label for each\nClientServerOperation\ndefined\nin the\nServiceInterface\nwith the role\nmethod\n, where:\n\nThe integer value of the case label shall be a 32-bit hash of the\nClientServerOperation\n's\nshortName\n. The binding implementation\nshall compute the hash as specified in section 7.5.1.1.2 of [22]. Represen-\ntations of the service interface in OMG IDL [24] shall define 32-bit signed\ninteger constants (i.e.,\nconst int32 <svcId>Method_<methodName>\n_Hash\n; where\n<methodName>\nis the\nshortName\nof the\nClientServer-\nOperation\n) to simplify the representation of the union cases (see below).\n\nThe member name for the case label shall be the\nshortName\nof the\nClientServerOperation\n.\n\nThe type for each case label shall be\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>\n_Result\n, which shall be constructed as specified in section 7.5.1.1.4 of\n[22] (see below).\nThe IDL definition of\n<svcId>Method_Return\nis the following:\n1\nunion <svcId>Method_Return switch(int32) {\n2\ndefault:\n3\ndds::rpc::UnknownOperation unknownOp;\n4\ncase <svcId>Method_<method0Name>_Hash:\n5\n<svcId>Method_<method0Name>_Result <method0Name>;\n6\ncase <svcId>Method_<method1Name>_Hash:\n7\n<svcId>Method_<method1Name>_Result <method1Name>;\n8\n// ...\n9\ncase <svcId>Method_<methodNName>_Hash:\n10\n<svcId>Method_<methodNName>_Result <methodNName>\n11\n};\nAs defined in section 7.5.1.1.5 of [22], the\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>_Re-\nsult\nunion shall be constructed as follows:\n\u000f\nThe union discriminator shall be a 32-bit signed integer.\n\u000f\nThe union shall have a case with label\ndds::RETCODE_OK\nto represent a suc-\ncessful return:\n\nThe value of\nRETCODE_OK\nshall be 0x00, as specified in section 2.3.3 of\n[19].\n\nThe successful case shall have a single member named\nresult\nof type\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>_Out\n(see below).\n\u000f\nThe union shall also have a case with label\ndds::RETCODE_ERROR\nto represent\nthe\nApApplicationError\nthe method may return:\n\nThe value of\nRETCODE_ERROR\nshall be 0x01, as specified in section 2.3.3\nof [19].\n\nThe error case shall have a single member named\nerror\nof type\nara::\ncore::ErrorCode\n(see [SWS_CM_10428]).\n191 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P192_355",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_10431",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 192,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nThe IDL representation of\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>_Result\nis the follow-\ning:\n1\nunion <svcId>Method_<methodName>_Result switch(int32) {\n2\ncase dds::RETCODE_OK:\n3\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>_Out result;\n4\ncase dds::RETCODE_ERROR:\n5\nara::core::ErrorCode error;\n6\n};\nLastly, as defined in section 7.5.1.1.5 of [22], the\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>\n_Out\nstructure be constructed as follows:\n\u000f\nThe structure shall contain as members all the\nArgumentDataPrototype\ns of\nthe\nClientServerOperation\nwith\ndirection\nset to\nout\nor\ninout\n.\n\u000f\nThe members of the structure representing\nout\nand\ninout\narguments shall ap-\npear in the structure in the same order as they were declared.\n\u000f\nIf the method has no\nout\n, and no\ninout\narguments, the structure shall contain\na single member named\ndummy\nof type\ndds::rpc::UnusedMember\n(in accor-\ndance with section 7.5.1.1.1 of [22]).\nThe IDL representation of\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>_Out\nis the following:\n1\nstruct <svcId>Method_<methodName>_Out {\n2\n<ArgumentDataPrototype[0]>;\n3\n<ArgumentDataPrototype[1]>;\n4\n// ...\n5\n<ArgumentDataPrototype[n]>;\n6\n};\nThe resulting Reply Topic data type shall be encoded according to the DDS serial-\nization rules. Unions, such as the\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>_Result\nunion,\nshall be serialized as specified in section 7.4.3.5 of [21].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_-\n00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_CM_00200, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00007)\n[SWS_CM_10431] Mapping of ara::core::ErrorCode\nd\nA\nApApplicationError\nshall be represented according to the following IDL [24]:\n1\nmodule dds {\n2\nmodule ara {\n3\nmodule core {\n4\n5\nstruct ErrorCode {\n6\nuint64 error_domain_value;\n7\nint32 error_code;\n8\n};\n9\n10\n}; // module core\n11\n}; // module ara\n12\n}; // module dds\nWhere:\n192 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

which the raised\nApApplicationError\nbe-\nlongs.\nerror_code\nis a 32-bit signed integer representing the\nApApplicationError\n.\ner-\nrorCode\n, which is represented on binding level as\nara::core::ErrorCode::\nValue()\n.\nara::core::ErrorCode\nshall be serialized according to the DDS serialization rules.\nSince IDL modules are translated to C++ namespaces during IDL to C++ code gener-\nation, the additional top-level module\ndds\nprevents clashing of the generated C++ type\nwith ara::com's own\nara::core::ErrorCode\ndefinition.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, FO_RS_-\nDds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00007)\nThe DDS serialization rules are defined in section 7.4.3.7.\n[SWS_CM_11103] Creating a DataWriter to handle method requests on the client\nside\nd\nThe DDS binding shall create a DDS DataWriter for the Request Topic asso-\nciated with the\nmethod\ns of the\nServiceInterface\n(see [SWS_CM_11101]) upon\nproxy instantiation.\nIf the provided or consumed Service Instance has been advertised with the\nidenti-\nfier_type\nattribute set to\nSERVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, to ensure\nthe proxy communicates only with the service instance it is bound to, the binding im-\nplementation shall use the DDS Publisher created in [SWS_CM_11009] (whose par-\ntition name is\n\"ara.com://services/<svcId>_<reqSvcInId>\"\n) to create the\nDataWriter.\nThe DataWriter shall be configured as follows:\n\u000f\nDataWriterQos\nshall be set as specified in the Manifest, where the\nDdsRe-\nquiredServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nqosProfile\nthat shall be\nused.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00015)\n[SWS_CM_11104] Creating a DataReader to handle method responses on the\nclient side\nd\nThe DDS binding shall create a DDS DataReader for the Reply Topic\nassociated with the\nmethod\ns of the\nServiceInterface\n(see [SWS_CM_11102])\nupon proxy instantiation.\nIf the provided or consumed Service Instance has been advertised with the\nidenti-\nfier_type\nattribute set to\nSERVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, to ensure\nthe proxy communicates only with the service instance it is bound to, the binding im-\nplementation shall use the DDS Subscriber created in [SWS_CM_11009] (whose par-\ntition name is\n\"ara.com://services/<svcId>_<reqSvcInId>\"\n) to create the\nDataReader.\nThe DataReader shall be configured as follows:\n193 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

the\nDdsRe-\nquiredServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nqosProfile\nthat shall be\nused.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_CM_00215, FO_RS_Dds_-\n00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\n[SWS_CM_11105] Creating a DataReader to handle method requests on the\nserver side\nd\nThe DDS binding shall create a DDS DataReader for the Request Topic\nassociated with the\nmethod\ns of the\nServiceInterface\n(see [SWS_CM_11101]) as\npart of the\nOfferService()\noperation (see [SWS_CM_11001]).\nIf the provided or consumed Service Instance has been advertised with the\nidenti-\nfier_type\nattribute set to\nSERVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, the bind-\ning shall use the DDS Subscriber created in [SWS_CM_11002] (whose partition name\nis\n\"ara.com://services/<svcId>_<svcInId>\"\n) to create the DataReader.\nThe DataReader shall be configured as follows:\n\u000f\nDataReaderQos\nshall be set as specified in the Manifest, where the\nDdsPro-\nvidedServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nqosProfile\nthat shall be used.\n\u000f\nListener\nand\nStatusMask\nshall be set according to the value of\nMethod-\nCallProcessingMode\nthat was selected in the constructor of the\nSer-\nviceSkeleton\nclass:\n\nFor\nMethodCallProcessingMode = kEvent\nor\nkEventSin-\ngleThread\n,\nListener\nshall be set to an instance of the\nDataRead-\nerListener\nclass specified in [SWS_CM_11110], and\nStatusMask\nshall\nbe set to\nDATA_AVAILABLE_STATUS\n.\n\nFor\nMethodCallProcessingMode = kPoll\n,\nListener\nshall remain\nunset, and\nStatusMask\nshall be set to\nSTATUS_MASK_NONE\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\n[SWS_CM_11106] Creating a DataWriter to handle method responses on the\nserver side\nd\nThe DDS binding shall create a DDS DataWriter for the Reply Topic\nassociated with the\nmethod\ns of the\nServiceInterface\n(see [SWS_CM_11102]) as\npart of the\nOfferService()\noperation (see [SWS_CM_11101]).\nIf the provided or consumed Service Instance has been advertised with the\nidenti-\nfier_type\nattribute set create the\nDataWriter.\nThe DataWriter shall be configured as follows:\n\u000f\nDataWriterQos\nshall be set as specified in the Manifest, where the\nDdsPro-\nvidedServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nqosProfile\nthat shall be used.\n194 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00015)\n[SWS_CM_11107] Calling a service method from the client side\nd\nWhen instructed\nto call a method from the client side, the DDS binding shall construct a new sam-\nple of the Request Topican instance of the Request Topic data type defined in\n[SWS_CM_11101])as follows:\n\u000f\nTo initialize the\nRequestHeader\nobject,\n\nrequestId\nshall be set by the underlying DDS implementation according\nto the rules specified in [22].\n\ninstanceName\nshall be set by the binding implementation to the\nservi-\nceInstanceId\nof the remote service instance.\n\u000f\nTo initialize the\n<svcId>Method_Call\nobject, the binding implementation shall\nfirst select the appropriate union case (as specified in [SWS_CM_11101], the\nhash of the method's name is the union discriminator that selects the union case),\nand then set accordingly the structure containing all the\nin\nand\ninout\nargu-\nments.\nThat sample shall then be passed as a parameter to the\nwrite()\nmethod of the DDS\nDataWriter created in [SWS_CM_11103] to handle method requests on the client side,\nwhich shall serialize the sample according to the DDS serialization rules, and publish\nit over DDS.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00015)\nThe DDS serialization rules are defined in section 7.4.3.7.\n[SWS_CM_11108] Notifying the client of a response to a method call\nd\nTo notify\nthe client application of a response as a result of a method call, the DDS binding\nimplementation shall invoke either the\nset_value()\noperation or the\nSetError()\noperation of the\nara::core::Promise\ncorresponding to the\nara::core::Future\nthat is returned to the caller.\nIf the discriminator of the\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>_Result\nunion holding\nthe response for the specific method call in the received DDS Reply Topic sample is\ndds::RETCODE_OK\n(i.e., 0 as defined in [19]), the binding implementation shall call the\nara::core::Promise\n's\nset_value()\noperation (see [SWS_CORE_00345] and\n[SWS_CORE_00346]) using the members representing the\nout\nand\ninout\nargu-\nments in the corresponding\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>_Out result\n(see\n[SWS_CM_11102]).\nElse, for any other discriminator value, the binding implementation shall call the\nara::\ncore::Promise\n's\nSetError()\noperation (see [SWS_CORE_00353]) with the cor-\nresponding\nara::core::ErrorCode\n, which is based on the corresponding\nApAp-\nplicationError\n(see [SWS_CM_11102]).\nIn either case, the associated set operation shall be performed upon the recep-\ntion of a new Reply Topic sample by the corresponding DDS DataReader (see\n195 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P196_359",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11104",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 196,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_11104]). The DDS binding shall use the DataReader's\ntake()\nto pro-\ncess the sample. Moreover, to correlate a request with a response, the binding shall\ncompare the\nheader.relatedRequestId\nof the received sample with the original\nrequestId\nthat was set and sent in [SWS_CM_11107]\n11 12\n.\nIf a received\nrelatedRequestId\ndoes not correspond to a\nrequestId\nthat has been\nsent by the client, the response shall be discarded.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212,\nRS_CM_00213, RS_CM_00215, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_-\nDds_00015)\n[SWS_CM_11109] Processing a method call on the server side (event driven)\nd\nIn case a\nMethodCallProcessingMode\nof either\nkEvent\nor\nkEventSin-\ngleThread\nhas been passed to the constructor of the\nServiceSkeleton\n(see\n[SWS_CM_00130]), the binding implementation shall create a\nDataReaderLis-\ntener\nto process the requests asynchronouslyas described in [SWS_CM_11110]\nand attach an instance of it to the DataReader processing the requests in accordance\nwith [SWS_CM_11105]. The listener is responsible for identifying the method that\nshall process the request and dispatch it (see [SWS_CM_11110]).\nc\n(RS_CM_00204,\nRS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_-\nDds_00016)\n[SWS_CM_11110] Creating a DataReaderListener to process asynchronous re-\nquests on the server side\nd\nAccording to [SWS_CM_11105], a\nMethodCallPro-\ncessingMode\nof either\nkEvent\nor\nkEventSingleThread\nrequires the instantiation\nof a DataReaderListener to process asynchronously requests on the server side. The\nresulting listener shall derive from the standard\nDataReaderListener\nclass [19],\nspecifying that the data type of the samples to be handled is the Request Topic data\ntype defined in [SWS_CM_11101].\nThe\nDataReaderListener\nshall implement the following methods according to the\nspecified instructions:\n\u000f\nAn\non_data_available()\nmethod responsible for reading the received re-\nquests from the DataReader's cacheusing the\ntake()\noperationand dis-\npatching them to the appropriate methods for processing. To identify the\nmethod of the\nServiceSkeleton\nclass that shall process each request,\non_data_available()\nshall use the union discriminator of the\n<svcId>\nMethod_Call\nand provide the destination method with the specific\nArgument-\nDataPrototype\ns in the union case."
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P196_360",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11104",
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 196,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "11\nThe RPC over DDS specification [22] does not mandate a specific mechanism or context to in-\nvoke the\ntake()\noperation on the DataReader that subscribes to method replies.Implementers of this\nspecification may therefore follow different approaches to address this issue.\n12\nFor instance, a proxy could provide a\nara::core::Map<dds::SampleIdentity,\nara::core::Promise<T> >\nto hold the\nara::core::Promise\ns assigned to every request\n(identified by their\ndds::SampleIdentity requestId\n), and install a\nDataReaderListener\n(on\nthe DataReader created in [SWS_CM_11104]) with an\non_data_available()\nmethod that could\ncall the setter of the corresponding\nara::core::Promise\nusing the\nrelatedRequestId\nof the\nreceived Reply Topic sample to address it. Alternatively, a compliant solution could also call\ntake()\nin\nthe context of a\nstd::async\nusing a\ndds::core::Waitset\n[19] to block until the reception of the\nexpected sample.\n196 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\n[SWS_CM_11111] Processing a method call on the server side (polling)\nd\nIn\ncase a\nMethodCallProcessingMode\nof\nkPoll\nhas been passed to the construc-\ntor of the\nServiceSkeleton\n(see [SWS_CM_00130]), the\nProcessNextMethod-\nCall\nmethod is be responsible for calling\ntake()\non the DataReader processing\nthe Request Topic associated with the service (see [SWS_CM_11105]).\nProcess-\nNextMethodCall\n, shall take only the first sample from the DataReader's cache and\ndispatch the call the appropriate service method (see [SWS_CM_00191]) of the\nSer-\nviceSkeleton\nclass according to the value of the of the discriminator of the\n<sv-\ncId>Method_Call\nunion and provide the destination method with the specific\nAr-\ngumentDataPrototype\ns in the union case.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_-\nCM_00213, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\n[SWS_CM_11112] Sending a method call response from the server side\nd\nThe\nbinding implementation shall send a response upon the return (either as a result of a\nnormal return or through one of the possible\nApApplicationError\ns referenced by\nthe\nClientServerOperation\nin the role\npossibleApError\n) of the service method\n(see [SWS_CM_10306] and [SWS_CM_10307]).\nTo send the response, the DDS binding shall construct a new sample of the Reply Topic\nan instance of the Reply Topic data type defined in [SWS_CM_11102])as follows:\n\u000f\nTo initialize the\nReplyHeader\nobject,\n\nrelatedRequestId\nshall be set to the value of the\nheader.re-\nquestId\nattribute of the request that triggered the method call (see\n[SWS_CM_11107]).\n\u000f\nTo initialize the\n<svcId>Method_Return\nobject, the binding implementation\nshall:\n\nSelect the appropriate union case (as specified in [SWS_CM_11102], the\nhash of the method's name is the union discriminator that selects the union\ncase).\n\nSet the\n<svcId>Method_<methodName>_Result\nunion selecting its\nunion discriminator based on whether the operation generated the correct\nresult or raised an\nApApplicationError\n:\n\u0003\nIf operation generated the correct result, the binding shall select the\nunion case for\ndds::RETCODE_OK\nand set the\n<svcId>Method_\n<methodName>_Out\nstructure with all the\nout\nand\ninout\narguments.\n\u0003\nOtherwise, if the operation raised an\nApApplicationError\n, the bind-\ning shall select the union case 0x01 and construct the corresponding\nara::core::ErrorCode (see [SWS_CM_11102]).\nThe sample shall then be passed as a parameter to the\nwrite()\nmethod of the DDS\nDataWriter created in [SWS_CM_11105] to handle method responses on the server\n197 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nside, which shall serialize the sample according to the DDS serialization rules, and pub-\nlish it over DDS.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213,\nFO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00015)\nThe DDS serialization rules are defined in section 7.4.3.7.\n7.4.3.6 Handling Fields\n[SWS_CM_11130] Mapping Fields with hasNotifier attribute to DDS Topics\nd\nThe\nDDS binding shall assign a DDS Topic to every\nField\ndefined in the\nServiceInter-\nface\nin the role\nfield\nwith\nhasNotifier = true\nto enable its notification semantics\nover DDS. The equivalent DDS Topic shall be configured as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Topic Name shall be derived from the Manifest according to the following\nrules:\n\nIf the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set\nto\nSERVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\nor\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_INSTANCE_ID\n, then the topic name shall\nbe set to\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<Major>.<Minor>\n/<TopicName>\n\nAdditionally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has\nbeen advertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, then samples of this topic shall\nbe sent and received via DataWriters and DataReaders whose respective\nparent Publisher and Subscriber objects include the following partition in the\nPARTITION QoS policy:\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<In-\nstanceId>\n\nFinally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_TOPIC_PREFIX\n, then the topic name shall be set\nto\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<InstanceID>/<Topic-\nName>\n\nWhere:\n<InterfaceID>\nis the value of\nDdsServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nserviceInterfaceId\n<InstanceID>\nis the value of either\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\n.\nserviceInstanceId\nor\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\n.\nre-\nquiredServiceInstanceId\n<Major> and <Minor>\nare the values of\nServiceInterface\n.\nma-\njorVersion\nand\nServiceInterface\n.\nminorVersion\n, respectively\n198 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },

      "source_page": 199,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n<TopicName>\nis the value of\nDdsEventDeployment\n.\ntopicName\ndefined\nfor\nDdsFieldDeployment\nin the\nnotifier\nrole\n\u000f\nThe Topic Data Type shall be defined as specified in [SWS_CM_11131], and shall\nbe registered under the equivalent data type's name.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00005)\n[SWS_CM_11131] Field Notifier DDS Topic data type definition\nd\nThe data type of a\nDDS Topic representing a Field Notifier shall be constructed according to the following\nIDL definition:\n1\nstruct <fieldTypeName>FieldNotifierType {\n2\n@key uint16 instance_id;\n3\n<fieldTypeName> data;\n4\n};\nWhere:\n<fieldTypeName>\nis the\nCpp Implementation Data Type symbol\n[25].\ninstance_id\nis a\n@key\nmember of the type, which identifies all samples with the\nsame\ninstance_id\nas samples of the same Topic Instance.\ndata\nis the actual value of the\nfield\n, which shall be constructed and encoded ac-\ncording to the DDS serialization rules. The\n@external\nannotation is optionally\nallowed, for cases where references yield implementation benefits over values.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00007)\nThe DDS serialization rules are defined in section 7.4.3.7.\n[SWS_CM_11132] Mapping of Update method\nd\nWhen instructed to transmit a field\nnotification message, the DDS binding shall construct a new sample of the equivalent\nDDS Topic data type (see [SWS_CM_11131]) as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Instance Id field (\ninstance_id\n) shall be derived from the Manifest, where\nthe\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\nelement defines the\nserviceInstan-\nceId\n.\n\u000f\nThe Data field (\ndata\n) shall point to the data input parameter of the\nUpdate()\nmethod.\nThat sample shall be then passed as a parameter to the\nwrite()\nmethod of the DDS\nDataWriter associated with the\nfield\n, which shall serialize the sample according to\nthe DDS serialization rules specified, and publish it over DDS.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_-\nCM_00201, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00015)\nThe DDS serialization rules are defined in section 7.4.3.7.\n[SWS_CM_11133] Mapping of Subscribe method\nd\nWhen instructed to subscribe to a\nfield, the DDS binding shall create a DDS DataReader to handle the subscription using\nthe DDS Subscriber created for the proxy in [SWS_CM_11002]. The rules to create\n199 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P200_364",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11134",

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nthe DataReader are specified in [SWS_CM_11134].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00103,\nFO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\n[SWS_CM_11134] Creating a DDS DataReader for field subscription\nd\nThe\nDDS binding shall create a DDS DataReader for the Topic associated with\nthe\nfield\n(see [SWS_CM_11130]). If the provided or consumed Service In-\nstance has been advertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, to ensure the proxy communicates only\nwith the service intsance it is bound to, the binding implementation shall use the DDS\nSubscriber created in [SWS_CM_11009] (whose partition name is\n\"ara.com://-\nservices/<svcId>_<reqSvcInId>\"\n) to create the DataReader.\nThe DataReader shall be configured as follows:\n\u000f\nDataReaderQos\nshall be set as specified in the Manifest, where the\nDdsField-\nQosProps\nelement defines the\nqosProfile\nthat shall be used. To configure\nthe DataReader's cache size according to the field subscription semantics, the\nmaxSampleCount\nspecified in the\nSubscribe()\nmethod call, the value of the\nDataReader's HISTORY QoS specified in\nqosProfile\nshall be overridden as\nfollows:\n\nhistory.kind = KEEP_LAST_HISTORY_QOS\n\nhistory.depth = <maxSampleCount>\nMoreover, to ensure that the proxy received the current value of the field as soon\nas it creates the subscription, the DataReaders's DURABILITY QoS shall be over-\nridden as follows:\n\ndurability.kind = TRANSIENT_LOCAL_DURABILITY_QOS\nLikewise, the RELIABILITY QoS shall be overridden as follows:\n\nreliability.kind = RELIABLE_RELIABILITY_QOS\n\u000f\nListener\nshall be an instance of the\nDataReaderListener\nclass specified in\n[SWS_CM_11135].\n\u000f\nStatusMask\nshall be set to\nSTATUS_MASK_NONE\n.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00103, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00016, FO_RS_Dds_00005)\n[SWS_CM_11135] Creating a DDS DataReaderListener for field subscription\nd\nThe\nDDS implementation shall define a\nDataReaderListener\nclass to handle field noti-\nfications when a new sample is received and/or the matched status of the subscription\nchanges following the instructions specified in [SWS_CM_11020].\nThe\nDataReaderListener\nclass shall specify that the samples to be handled are of\nthe Topic data type specified in [SWS_CM_11131].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00103,\nFO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00005, FO_RS_Dds_00016)\n200 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n[SWS_CM_11136] Mapping of Unsubscribe method\nd\nWhen instructed to unsub-\nscribe from a field event, the DDS binding shall delete the DataReader associated with\nthe\nfield\nnotifier.\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00104, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11137] Mapping of GetSubscriptionState method\nd\nThe GetSubscrip-\ntionState method shall be mapped as specified in [SWS_CM_11022] using the\nDataReader created in [SWS_CM_11134].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00106, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11138] Mapping of GetNewSamples method\nd\nThe GetNewSamples\nmethod shall be mapped as specified in [SWS_CM_11023] using the DataReader\ncreated in [SWS_CM_11134].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00202, FO_RS_Dds_00001,\nFO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11139] Mapping of GetFreeSampleCount method\nd\nThe GetFreeSam-\npleCount method shall be mapped as specified in [SWS_CM_11024] using the\nDataReader created in [SWS_CM_11134].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00202, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11140] Mapping of SetReceiveHandler method\nd\nThe SetReceiveHan-\ndler method shall be mapped as specified in [SWS_CM_11025] using the DataReader\ncreated in [SWS_CM_11134].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00203, FO_RS_Dds_00001,\nFO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11141] Mapping of UnsetReceiveHandler method\nd\nThe UnsetRe-\nceiveHandler method shall be mapped as specified in [SWS_CM_11026] using the\nDataReader created in [SWS_CM_11134].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00203, FO_-\nRS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11142] Mapping of SetSubscriptionStateHandler method\nd\nThe SetSub-\nscriptionStateHandler method shall be mapped as specified in [SWS_CM_11027] us-\ning the DataReader created in [SWS_CM_11134].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00106,\nFO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11143] Mapping of UnsetSubscriptionStateHandler method\nd\nThe UnsetSubscriptionStateHandler method shall be mapped as specified in\n[SWS_CM_11028] using the DataReader created in [SWS_CM_11134].\nc\n(RS_CM_-\n00204, RS_CM_00106, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008)\n[SWS_CM_11144] Mapping of Field Get/Set methods to DDS Service Methods\nand Topics\nd\nEvery\nServiceInterface\ncontaining one or more\nField\ns defined in\nthe role\nfield\nwith\nhasGetter\nor\nhasSetter\nattributes set to\ntrue\nshall have an\nassociated DDS Service to enable ara::com Service Instances to offer those opera-\ntions, and to enable client applications to invoke them. The equivalent DDS Service\nshall provide the getter and setter methods for all the\nfield\ns in the corresponding\nServiceInterface\n.\nIn compliance with [SWS_CM_11100], these DDS Services shall be constructed ac-\ncording to the Basic Service Mapping Profile of the RPC over DDS specification [22].\n201 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P202_366",
      "source_element": "SWS_CM_11145",

      "source_page": 202,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nThus, every\nServiceInterface\ncontaining one or more\nfield\ns with the\nhasGet-\nter\nor\nhasSetter\nattributes enabled shall trigger the creation of a pair of DDS Topics:\na Request Topic and a Reply Topic.\nThe equivalent DDS Request Topic shall be configured as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Request Topic Name shall be derived from the Manifest according to the\nfollowing rules:\n\nIf the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSERVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\nor\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_INSTANCE_ID\n, then the topic name shall\nbe set to\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<Major>.<Minor>\n/<TopicName>\n\nAdditionally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has\nbeen advertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, then samples of this topic shall\nbe sent and received via DataWriters and DataReaders whose respective\nparent Publisher and Subscriber objects include the following partition in the\nPARTITION QoS policy:\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<In-\nstanceId>\n\nFinally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_TOPIC_PREFIX\n, then the topic name shall be set\nto\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<InstanceID>/<Topic-\nName>\n\nWhere:\n<InterfaceID>\nis the value of\nDdsServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nserviceInterfaceId\n<InstanceID>\nis the value of either\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\n.\nserviceInstanceId\nor\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\n.\nre-\nquiredServiceInstanceId\n<Major> and <Minor>\nare the values of\nServiceInterface\n.\nma-\njorVersion\nand\nServiceInterface\n.\nminorVersion\n, respectively\n<TopicName>\nis the value of\nDdsServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nfieldRequestTopicName\n\u000f\nThe Request Topic Data Type shall be defined as specified in [SWS_CM_11145].\nThe equivalent DDS Reply Topic shall be configured as follows:\n\u000f\nThe Reply Topic Name shall be derived from the Manifest according to the fol-\nlowing rules:\n202 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"

      "source_page": 203,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\n\nIf the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSERVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\nor\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_INSTANCE_ID\n, then the topic name shall\nbe set to\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<Major>.<Minor>\n/<TopicName>\n\nAdditionally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has\nbeen advertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_RESOURCE_PARTITION\n, then samples of this topic shall\nbe sent and received via DataWriters and DataReaders whose respective\nparent Publisher and Subscriber objects include the following partition in the\nPARTITION QoS policy:\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<In-\nstanceId>\n\nFinally, if the provided or consumed Service Instance has been\nadvertised with the\nidentifier_type\nattribute set to\nSER-\nVICE_INSTANCE_TOPIC_PREFIX\n, then the topic name shall be set\nto\nara.com://services/<InterfaceID>/<InstanceID>/<Topic-\nName>\n\nWhere:\n<InterfaceID>\nis the value of\nDdsServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nserviceInterfaceId\n<InstanceID>\nis the value of either\nDdsProvidedServiceInstance\n.\nserviceInstanceId\nor\nDdsRequiredServiceInstance\n.\nre-\nquiredServiceInstanceId\n<Major> and <Minor>\nare the values of\nServiceInterface\n.\nma-\njorVersion\nand\nServiceInterface\n.\nminorVersion\n, respectively\n<TopicName>\nis the value of\nDdsServiceInterfaceDeployment\n.\nfieldReplyTopicName\n\u000f\nThe Reply Topic Data Type shall be defined as specified in [SWS_CM_11146].\nc\n(RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_-\nDds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_00005)\n[SWS_CM_11145] DDS Service Request Topic data type definition for Field getter\nand setter operations\nd\nAs specified in section 7.5.1.1.6 of [22], the Request Topic\ndata type is a structure composed of a Request Header with meta-data and a Call\nStructure with data. The IDL definition of the Request Topic data type for the DDS\nService handling field getters and setters is the following:\n1\nstruct <svcId>Field_Request {\n2\ndds::rpc::RequestHeader header;\n3\n<svcId>Field_Call data;\n4\n};\n203 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
    {
      "id": "SNIP_com_AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_C_P204_368",
      "source_element": null,
      "source_document": "AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement",
      "source_page": 204,
      "category": "architectural_role",
      "verbatim_text": "Specification of Communication Management\nAUTOSAR AP R23-11\nWhere:\n<svcId>\nis the corresponding\nserviceInterfaceId\n.\ndds::rpc::RequestHeader\nis the standard Request Header defined in section\n7.5.1.1.1 of [22].\n<svcId>Field_Call\nis the union that holds the value of the input parameters of the\ncorresponding methods, according to the rules specified in section 7.5.1.1.6 of\n[22].\ndds::rpc::RequestHeader\nshall be constructed as specified in section 7.5.1.1.1\nof [22]. On top of that, the binding implementation shall set the\ninstanceName\n(a\nmember of the\nRequestHeader\nstructure that specifies the DDS service instance\nname) to a string representation of the\nserviceInstanceId\nof the service instance\nthat provides the fields (which have getters or setters).\n<svcId>Field_Call\nshall be constructed as specified in section 7.5.1.1.6 of [22].\n\u000f\nThe name of the union shall be\n<svcId>Field_Call\n.\n\u000f\nThe union discriminator shall be a 32-bit signed integer.\n\u000f\nThe union shall have a default case of type\ndds::rpc::UnknownOperation\n(defined in section 7.5.1.1.1 of [22]) for unsupported and unknown operations.\n\u000f\nThe union shall have a case label for each\nhasGetter\nand\nhasSetter\nattribute\nequal to\ntrue\nin the\nField\ns defined in the\nServiceInterface\nwith the role\nfield\n, where:\n\nThe integer value of the case label shall be a 32-bit hash of the field\ngetter or setter name. That is,\n\"Get<fieldName>\"\nand\n\"Set<field-\nName>\"\n; where\n<fieldName>\nis the\nshortName\nof the\nField\n. The\nbinding implementation shall compute the hash as specified in section\n7.5.1.1.2 of [22]. Representations of the service interface in OMG IDL [24]\nshall define 32-bit signed integer constants (i.e.,\nconst int32 <svcId>\nField_Get<fieldName>_Hash\nor\nconst int32 <svcId>Field_Set\n<fieldName>_Hash\n) to simplify the representation of the union cases (see\nbelow).\n\nThe member name for the case label shall be\nget<FieldName>\nfor getter\nmethods and\nset<FieldName>\nfor setter methods.\n\nThe type for each case level shall be\n<svcId>Field_Get<fieldName>\n_In\nfor getter methods, and\n<svcId>Field_Set<fieldName>_In\nfor\nsetter methods, which shall be constructed as specified in section 7.5.1.1.4\nof [22] (see below).\nThe IDL definition of the\n<svcId>Field_Call\nunion is the following:\n1\nunion <svcId>Field_Call switch(int32) {\n2\ndefault:\n3\ndds::rpc::UnknownOperation unknownOp;\n204 of 525 Document ID 717: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_CommunicationManagement"
    },
